title: Machine Shop
description:
Virtual Assistant / Office Admin — Machine Shop (Full-Time, US Hours)

Pay: $6.00/hour to start, USD (room to grow as the shop grows — see below) Hours: Full-time, 40 hrs/week, US Pacific business hours (PST/PDT) Schedule: Monday–Friday Type: Long-term, full-time independent contractor position



About the Shop

We're a small but growing CNC machine shop. Right now it's a tight team — the owner is both the lead machinist and the person fielding every phone call,
, and quote request. That's about to change.



We're looking for our first dedicated Virtual Assistant to take over the admin side of the business completely, so the owner can get back on the floor doing what he does best: running machines. This is a foundational hire — as the shop adds more machinists, your role grows with it. You won't be one of many VAs lost in a big team; you'll be the backbone of how this shop runs day to day.



If you've worked in a machine shop, manufacturing, or fabrication environment before — even better. You'll already understand the language, the urgency, and what "the customer needs this part by Friday" actually means.



What You'll Be Doing

Client Communication



Answer incoming phone calls from clients (yes, real phone calls — comfort and confidence on the phone is a must)

Make outbound calls when needed (quote follow-ups, scheduling, payment reminders)

Manage the
 inbox: respond to client inquiries, route questions, keep things from falling through the cracks

Quoting & Sales Support



Manage incoming quote requests and keep the quoting pipeline organized

Follow up with prospects who haven't responded to a quote

Track quote status from "sent" to "won/lost" so nothing goes stale

Accounts Receivable / Payment Follow-Up



Send polite, professional payment reminder
s and calls to clients with outstanding invoices

Keep a simple log of who's been contacted and when

Office & Task Management



Keep the shop's task boards (Trello/Notion) up to date and organized

Manage the owner's inbox and calendar so he's not buried in admin between machine cycles

General office admin: filing, data entry, document organization, ordering supplies, whatever keeps the shop running smoothly

Communicate daily with the owner via Slack for updates, questions, and priorities

What We're Looking For

Required:



Strong professional English — written and spoken. You don't need a "perfect" accent, but clients need to understand you clearly and you need to sound confident and competent on the phone

Comfortable and confident making/answering phone calls to US clients — this is a core part of the job, not occasional

Solid experience as a Virtual Assistant or office admin (2+ years preferred)

Proficient with Outlook 
/calendar), Slack, Trello, and Notion — or able to pick these up fast

Highly organized self-starter — you'll often be managing your own priority list with light supervision

Reliable internet connection, backup power/internet solution, and a quiet space for calls

Available to work US Pacific business hours, full-time

Strongly Preferred:



Previous experience as an office admin, customer service rep, or VA for a machine shop, fabrication shop, manufacturing company, or similar industrial/technical business

Familiarity with manufacturing terms (tolerances, materials, lead times, quotes/POs) — or genuine willingness to learn them quickly

Experience handling accounts receivable or payment follow-up communications

Experience managing a quoting or sales pipeline

Why This Role

You're the first VA hire — you'll help shape how the admin side of this business runs as it scales, not just follow a rigid playbook

Real growth path — as the shop adds machinists and volume increases, your responsibilities (and pay) grow with it. This isn't a static, capped role

Direct line to the owner — no layers of management, no corporate bureaucracy. You'll work closely with the person making the decisions

Stability — this is a long-term position for the right person, not a short-term project

How to Apply

Please apply with the following so we can move quickly:



A short cover message telling us about your experience — specifically mention if you've worked in a machine shop, manufacturing, or industrial business before

Your resume

A short voice recording (1–2 minutes) introducing yourself — we want to hear how you sound on a call

Your available start date and confirmation you can work US Pacific hours full-time

We're hiring soon — applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

title: AI (Artificial Intelligence) Image Specialist
description:
Urgent Hiring: AI IMAGE SPECIALIST

Reports To: Creative Asset Manager

Work Hours: 40 hours weekly - Flexible Time



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



This is an AI-first role. 



We are not looking for a traditional graphic designer who occasionally uses AI. We are looking for someone who actively uses AI image generation and editing tools as a core part of their creative process and is passionate about staying ahead of emerging AI technologies. 



Candidates should be prepared to share examples of AI-generated work, discuss their preferred AI tools and workflows, and demonstrate how they use AI to increase creative output and efficiency. 



Company Vision: 

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field.  We value problem solvers, go getters, and people with opinions who want to make an impact.  You will be on the leading edge of graphic design and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.   



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides.  Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products.  We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us! 



That’s where you come in as our AI Image Specialist. 



Role Purpose 

This role is responsible for designing creative and compelling visuals for new and existing products, including illustrations, packaging, and listing images primarily through AI-powered workflows. You will also create diverse marketing materials such as social media graphics and website elements, as needed. 



THIS IS AN AI-FIRST ROLE. 



Primary Objectives 

Lead AI-powered image creation and continuously improve visual production through emerging AI tools and workflows.

Collaborate with the graphics manager & design tea
mbers to align designs with objectives.

Optimize product images to meet e-commerce guidelines and boost performance.

Deliver realistic, high-quality, on-brand ai generated imagery,designs and videos for listings and marketing materials. 



Regular Work Activities 

Research, test, and implement new AI image generation and editing tools. 

Develop effective product visuals, including listing graphics, packaging & instructions aligned with brand identity and target audience using AI workflows. 

Collaborate with the graphic design team. 

Edit and enhance product photography through AI generation. 

Perform necessary edits to create polished and post-ready graphics. 



Key Skills 

Intermediate to Expert-level proficiency with AI image generation platforms. 

Expertise in graphic design, illustration, and photo editing 

Always updating AI knowledge to best use new software and processes. 

Proficient in design tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, etc.) 

Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams 

Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines 

Knowledge of current design trends and techniques 

Self-starter who raises issues and proposes solutions before asked – a critical thinker who finds mistakes and corrects them 



Role Requirements 

3+ years of experience in graphic design or visual content creation 

Proven experience designing for e-commerce platforms (Amazon, Shopify, etc.) 

Daily user of AI image generation tools such as OpenAi/ChatGPT, Nani Banana/ Google Gemini, Claude, Midjourney, Dall-e, etc. 

Proven history of learning and implementing new AI tools independently. 

Strong portfolio demonstrating expertise in product visuals and marketing collateral 

A degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or a related field (preferred)

title: PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT COORDINATOR
description:
PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT COORDINATOR

Synergy Wetsuits

Remote Independent Contractor Role



SUMMARY:

• Location: Remote / Philippines-based contractor

• Experience: 4+ years of project management, supply chain, logistics, product development, sporting goods, apparel, or related experience

• Engagement Type: Independent contractor

• Expected Service Hours: Approximately 30 hours per week

• Availability: Regular overlap with the Synergy team Monday–Friday, 11:00am–5:00pm US Pacific Time / 2:00am–8:00am Manila Time

• Contractor Rate: $10/hour, paid monthly upon receipt of invoice

• Additional Contractor Payments: Eligible for a discretionary year-end contractor payment and $50/month contractor support allowance



Synergy Wetsuits is a triathlon wetsuit, apparel, and accessories company based in Minden, Nevada, USA. We are looking for an experienced Product Development Coordinator to support our product development team with research, sampling, costing packages, trim details, sourcing, vendor communication, logistics coordination, and production follow-up.



This is a remote independent contractor engagement. The contractor will work with the Synergy team on product development tasks, production timelines, vendor follow-ups, sample tracking, and shipment coordination. The right person is organized, self-motivated, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple moving pieces without constant supervision.



At Synergy Wetsuits, we move fast, solve problems, and care deeply about creating great products for triathletes and swimmers. We are looking for someone proactive, reliable, flexible, and comfortable jumping in where needed. Every day is a little different, which keeps things interesting.



JOB DESCRIPTION:



The Product Development Coordinator will support the product development process from concept, design, sampling, production, and release. This role will help track product development timelines, communicate with overseas vendors, follow up on samples and revisions, organize product details, and coordinate information between internal teams and external partners.



The contractor will collaborate closely with the product development team and management to understand the creative direction of each product and help move projects forward. This includes supporting seasonal product calendars, vendor communication, sample tracking, shipment coordination, costing updates, and product documentation.



Regular team overlap is needed Monday–Friday, 11:00am–5:00pm US Pacific Time / 2:00am–8:00am Manila Time.



A background check may be required as part of the contractor screening process.



MUST HAVES:



• 4+ years of project management, supply chain, logistics, product development, sporting goods, apparel, or related experience

• Experience using Asana or a similar project management platform

• Strong problem-solving skills

• Strong follow-up and follow-through

• Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines at the same time

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Ability to build and maintain professional relationships with vendors and internal teams

• Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office, especially Word, Excel, and Outlook

• Strong organization, attention to detail, and ability to improve processes

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, goals-oriented environment

• Ability to communicate professionally with vendors, tea
mbers, and management

• Availability for regular team overlap Monday–Friday, 11:00am–5:00pm US Pacific Time / 2:00am–8:00am Manila Time



NICE TO HAVES:



• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Manufacturing, Textiles, or a related field

• Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud, especially Photoshop or Illustrator

• Experience in triathlon, swimming, sporting goods, apparel, or performance products

• Personal interest in triathlon, swimming, endurance sports, or fitness



SCOPE OF SERVICES:



• Create and manage the production calendar

• Create and manage product development status updates in Asana

• Support product development from initial concept, design, sampling, production, and release

• Conduct viability research for concept products

• Communicate product updates, timelines, and issues to internal teams and overseas vendors

• Track samples, revisions, approvals, and development progress

• Coordinate with product development, design, production, planning, materials, and quality-related teams

• Coordinate international shipments and customs clearance

• Organize product information for the Product Development, Marketing, Design, and vendor teams

• Help ensure target pricing, product details, and development timelines stay aligned

• Create and update weekly product development reports

• Create and maintain product packets

• Support the Product Manager with product development coordination and day-to-day project needs



ABOUT SYNERGY WETSUITS:



Synergy Wetsuits was founded in the early 1990s by Stefan Laursen. The brand was built around creating high-quality triathlon wetsuits, apparel, and accessories at a strong value, while staying connected to the sport and the athletes we serve.



Synergy is a tight-knit, high-performance multisport brand. We are looking for people who care about doing great work, improving processes, collaborating with the team, and helping us build one of the top triathlon brands in the world.



Our culture is entrepreneurial, fast-paced, collaborative, and practical. We work hard, solve problems, and keep moving.



INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR NOTICE:



This is a remote independent contractor engagement and does not create an employer-employee relationship. The contractor is responsible for their own taxes, government contributions, insurance, equipment, workspace, internet, and personal benefits unless otherwise agreed in writing.



HOW TO APPLY:



 the following to 



1. Responses to the questions below

2. Resume and cover letter

3. Short video introducing yourself, explaining why you are interested in this role, and why you think you would be a strong fit for Synergy Wetsuits



Application Questions:



1. Do you have experience in project management, supply chain, logistics, product development, sporting goods, apparel, or a related industry? If yes, how many years? Please describe your experience in detail.



2. Describe your experience managing projects in Asana or a similar project management platform. What types of projects did you manage?



3. Tell us about a time you had to follow up repeatedly with vendors, suppliers, or tea
mbers to keep a project on schedule.



4. How do you stay organized when managing multiple projects with competing deadlines?



5. Are you available for regular team overlap Monday–Friday, 11:00am–5:00pm US Pacific Time / 2:00am–8:00am Manila Time?



6. What experience do you have coordinating shipments, samples, inventory, production timelines, or vendor-related projects?



Applications missing the required responses, resume/cover letter, or video introduction may not be considered.

title: Experienced Credit Dispute Processor (Client Dispute Manager or Dispute fox & GoHighLevel Expert Required)
description:
We are a fast-growing US-based credit repair and funding company seeking an experienced, detail-oriented Credit Dispute Processor. You will be responsible for the entire backend fulfillment process of our credit repair clients.

You must be highly proficient with Client Dispute Manager (CDM) software or Dispute fox and understand how it integrates with GoHighLevel (GHL). Your goal is to analyze credit reports accurately, create high-quality dispute strategies, and ensure round-one and follow-up dispute letters are processed quickly.

Key Responsibilities:



* Credit Analysis: Pull and analyze 3-bureau credit reports (IdentityIQ, SmartCredit, MyScoreIQ, etc.) inside the Client Dispute Manager platform.

* Dispute Strategy: Identify inaccurate, unverified, and misleading negative items (collections, charge-offs, late payments, bankruptcies, inquiries).

* Letter Generation: Utilize CDM to draft customized, aggressive, and legally sound dispute letters using Factual Disputing and Metro 2 compliance standards.

* Data Entry & Management: Update client files, track dispute results, and log updates accurately inside CDM and GoHighLevel.

* Pipeline Coordination: Update client stages in the GHL pipeline so our Client Success Manager and automated text/emails stay perfectly synced.

* Mail Preparation: Package dispute letters with client IDs, utility bills, and required documentation to be exported for automated mailing (or local printing).

Required Qualifications & Skills:



* Software Mastery: Minimum 1–2 years of hands-on experience using Client Dispute Manager (CDM). Do not apply if you have never used this software.

* Tech Stack Savvy: Strong familiarity with GoHighLevel (GHL) pipelines and tags.

* Credit Knowledge: In-depth understanding of FCRA, CROA, and effective disputing methods (not just generic dispute templates).

* Speed & Accuracy: Ability to process client files within a strict 48-to-72-hour turnaround time.

* Communication: Excellent written English skills for internal team communication (Slack/WhatsApp) and clean documentation.

description:

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Visa Processing Officer / Migration Case Manager to join us and support Australian clients from our Philippines-based team. This role is responsible for managing end-to-end visa application processes, coordinating client communications, and supporting migration professionals to deliver a seamless and compliant immigration experience.

Administrative Support: Provide administrative assistance to the legal and migration team as required, while maintaining a primary focus on visa processing activities.

Minimum of 2–3 years of experience in visa processing, migration services, immigration support, or a similar role within a migration agency, consultancy, or law firm.  

Demonstrated experience handling Australian visa applications is highly preferred.  

Strong understanding of visa documentation requirements, application processes, and case management workflows.  

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the confidence to communicate directly with Australian clients.  

Ability to manage multiple active cases simultaneously while meeting strict deadlines.  

Exceptional attention to detail, particularly when reviewing documentation and compliance requirements.  

Proven ability to work independently within a remote or offshore support environment.  

Strong organisational and time management skills.  

Experience using CRM systems and case management platforms.  

Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with professionalism and discretion.  



Software Proficiency 

Productivity Tools – Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) 

CRM Systems – HubSpot or similar customer relationship management platforms 

Document Management Systems – Digital file and records management platforms 

Visa Processing Platforms – ImmiAccount and other online visa lodgement systems 



Education 

Bachelor’s Degree in Law, Legal Management, Business Administration, International Studies, or a related field.

title: Sales Operations Assistant (Remote)
description:
Sales Operations Assistant (Remote)



About Fitribe

Fitribe is an online health and fitness coaching company helping women over 40 lose weight and keep it off without extreme dieting.

We are growing and are looking for a highly organised and detail-focused Sales Operations Assistant to help keep our revenue systems clean, accurate, and controlled.



This is not a basic admin role.



This role is suited to someone who thrives on organisation, enjoys working with numbers and trackers, possesses a creative eye for basic design/social media management, and takes pride in making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



Position Details

* Role: Sales Operations Assistant

* Hours: 20 hours per week (Note: May transition to 40 hours per week)

* Location: Remote Contractor Role

* Reports To: Sales & Client Recovery Consultant



Main Outcome

Your primary responsibility is to keep our sales, recovery, referral, re-sign, commission, PayRight conversion, and CRM tracking systems accurate and up to date, while supporting the team with essential social media and asset creation needs.

Your job is to ensure the right information and assets are visible, correct, and actioned on time so the business can operate efficiently and make informed decisions.



Key Responsibilities

* Sales and setter scorecard management

* Sales tracker updates and maintenance

* Tracking booked calls, show rates, no-shows, closes, cash collected, and payment types

* Commission tracking preparation

* Referral and re-sign tracker management

* PayRight conversion tracker updates

* CRM note audits and checks

* Following up on missing information and incomplete data

* Identifying and reporting revenue-risk client issues

* Creating and updating basic visual assets using Canva

* Assisting with daily social media management, scheduling, or basic engagement coordination



What You Will Not Own

* Sales calls / Save calls

* Coaching decisions

* Pricing decisions

* Team management



Your role is to keep the systems clean, the data accurate, and the social platforms supported so the right people can make the right decisions.



You're a Strong Fit If You...

* Are extremely organised and notice details others often miss

* Love clean spreadsheets, accurate reporting, and are confident using Google Sheets

* Possess a strong working knowledge of Canva and understand social media best practices

* Are comfortable following up on missing information

* Can follow processes without constant reminders and communicate clearly/professionally

* Take ownership when things are messy

* Understand that missed notes, incorrect data, and missed follow-ups can directly impact revenue

* Work well independently and do not require micromanagement



You're Probably Not a Fit If You...

* Need constant reminders to complete tasks

* Avoid numbers, reporting, or digital platforms

* Frequently miss small details or wait for others to chase you

* Dislike spreadsheets, trackers, data entry, or routine administrative upkeep

* Have no experience or interest in creative tools like Canva or social media management

* Are looking for a simple admin role

* Are uncomfortable being held to clear standards and KPIs



Tools We Use

* Google Sheets

* Canva

* Social Media Platforms (Instagram,
, etc.)

* Slack & Asana

* GoHighLevel (or similar CRM platforms)

* Stripe & PayRight



Success in Your First 30 Days

* Scorecards and trackers are updated daily and submitted on time

* Missing data and revenue-risk issues are identified and flagged quickly

* Commission, referral, re-sign, and PayRight tracking are accurately maintained

* CRM note gaps are identified and addressed

* Canva assets and social media tasks are delivered consistently and on schedule

* The sales and marketing team has cleaner, more reliable support



How to Apply

1. Short Introduction – Tell us why you believe you're a strong fit for this role.

2. Relevant Experience – Outline your experience with Google Sheets, CRM systems, sales administration, tracking/reporting, as well as your experience with Canva and social media management.

3. Availability – Provide your current availability and confirm your flexibility should this role transition to 40 hours per week.

4. Loom Video (Maximum 3 Minutes)?“Tell us about a time you helped clean up, organise, or improve a messy admin, sales, tracking, reporting, or operations system. What was the problem, what did you do, and what improved?”

5. Written Response?“If you were checking our sales tracker daily, what are the first five things you would look for to make sure nothing important was missed?”



[!IMPORTANT] Applications that do not include both the Loom video and written response will not be reviewed.

To show you've read the full job post, please start your application with: “Clean data protects revenue.”

This is a hybrid role requiring a mix of organic social strategy, community management, and hands-on graphic design. You will not only plan the calendar, but you will also design the visual assets. - Reliable Setup: High-speed internet connection (with a backup plan) and a reliable smartphone and computer capable of handling design software smoothly.



Nice-to-Haves (Not Mandatory)

THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR

COMPENSATION & GROWTH PATH

Base: USD $300/month, part-time (20 hrs/week).

• After 90 days hitting agreed KPIs (consistent posting, growing engagement, early conversions) ? base rises to $500/month.

title: Regulatory Compliance Officer
description:
Australian compliance advisory firm, remote, part-time (room to grow)



About ComplyEdge



ComplyEdge is a boutique regulatory compliance and risk advisory firm based in Sydney, Australia. We help businesses across financial services, fintech, lending, real estate and professional services understand their regulatory obligations, manage compliance risk, and respond to regulators with confidence. Our work spans regulatory advisory, AML/CTF and financial crime, employment and industrial relations compliance, breach and i
 response, ongoing managed compliance, and compliance health reviews.

We are growing, and I am looking for a reliable research and documentation assistant to support that work.



The role



You will help me with the research, analysis and document work that sits behind ComplyEdge’s advisory services. That means reading regulations and regulator guidance, turning them into clear summaries, and drafting compliance documents from templates and instructions. The work covers all of our service lines and every industry we support, so no two weeks look quite the same.

This is a support role. I review all client-facing work before it is used, so you are never carrying regulatory advice on your own. What I need is someone careful, accurate and good with words.



The details

 • Rate: AUD $5.00 per hour (approximately USD $3.30 per hour, depending on the exchange rate)

 • Hours: 15 hours per week to begin, with room to increase as we build a working rhythm and the workload grows

 • Around AUD $325 per month to start

 • Location: remote, Philippines-based independent contractor

 • Most work is asynchronous, though some overlap with Australian Eastern time for occasional check-ins is a plus



What you will do



 • Research Australian regulatory developments, legislation and official guidance from bodies such as AUSTRAC, ASIC, the ATO, Fair Work and the OAIC, and summarise what matters

 • Analyse regulatory obligations and turn dense material into clear, structured briefing notes and summaries

 • Draft and format compliance documents, including policies, procedures, registers, checklists, templates and reports, working from instructions and existing templates

 • Support work across all of ComplyEdge’s service lines: regulatory advisory, AML/CTF and financial crime, employment and IR compliance, regulatory response and breach management, managed compliance retainers, and regulatory health reviews

 • Help keep our internal knowledge organised by tracking regulatory changes and maintaining document libraries

 • Support compliance work across the industries we serve, including financial services, fintech, lending and credit, real estate, and professional services



How the work runs



A few things matter to me, so I want to be clear about them upfront.

 • You work under my direction, and I review client-facing output before it goes anywhere. You provide research and drafting support, not regulatory advice.

 • Accuracy comes first. I expect work grounded in primary and official sources, with anything uncertain flagged rather than guessed. On regulatory detail, asking a question is always better than making something up.

 • You will handle confidential, client-sensitive information, and I expect complete discretion.



What I am looking for



 • Strong written English. You can take a regulation or a guidance note and explain it clearly and correctly.

 • A background or real aptitude in compliance, law, regulation, audit, or a related field.

 • Genuine research skills and comfort reading legislation and official guidance.

 • Close attention to detail and a methodical way of working.

 • Reliability and the ability to manage your own time and hit deadlines without me chasing you.

 • Discretion with sensitive material.



Nice to have



 • Familiarity with Australian regulatory frameworks such as AML/CTF, ASIC and AFSL requirements, Fair Work, or the Privacy Act

 • Exposure to financial services, fintech or lending compliance

 • Experience drafting policies, procedures or compliance registers

 • Confidence with everyday document and spreadsheet tools



How to apply



Please send me:

 1. A short note (a few paragraphs) on your relevant experience and why this role suits you.

 2. A brief writing task, so I can see how you research and write. In around 200 words and in plain English, explain one thing an Australian business must do under a regulatory obligation of your choice. Name the source you used.

 3. Your weekly availability and any overlap you can offer with Australian Eastern time.

 4. Confirmation that the rate works for you.

Applications that skip the writing task will not be considered.



This role has room to grow for the right person. If you take regulatory accuracy seriously and you write well, I would like to hear from you.

title: AI Recipe Video Clip Creator — Short-Form Food Content VA
description:
AI Recipe Video Clip Creator — Short-Form Food Content VA 



This is a great fit for an experienced VA who already has a job, steady income, or other clients, and wants a flexible side hustle with real long-term upside. This is not meant for someone who needs a high full-time salary immediately. It is paid from the beginning, but the bigger opportunity is participating in the upside through performance bonuses as the brand grows. The right person can keep their current job, work on their own schedule, and make a bet on something that has the potential to eventually make more money than their day job with less work. This is results-driven work for someone with long-term vision.



We are looking for a detail-oriented VA to help create realistic AI-generated food clips for recipe reels, TikTok videos, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other short-form social media content. Editing experience is a huge plus, especially if you already understand pacing, hooks, food visuals, short-form content, or what makes a clip feel polished and engaging.



You will be helping turn high-protein comfort meal prep food recipes into realistic, appetizing video clips using tools like Higgsfield, Claude, and JSON-based prompting/workflows.



We will teach the exact workflow, so you do not need to be an expert already. What matters most is that you have good taste, can follow instructions carefully, have a strong work ethic and can tell when food content looks realistic, delicious, and scroll-stopping. If you see this, write the word banana in your job title response. 



What You’ll Do



You will create batches of AI video clips for each recipe, including things like:



- Realistic cooking action shots  

- Ingredient prep clips  

- Sauce pours, cheese pulls, sizzling pans, plating shots, and meal prep container shots  

- High-quality clips that look appetizing, natural, and social-media ready  

- Prompting and adjusting clips using Claude, Higgsfield, and JSON instructions  

- Reviewing clips carefully and fixing details that look fake, messy, distorted, or unappetizing  

- Making edits when feedback is given  



The goal is to create short-form food videos that feel realistic, indulgent, high-protein, and visually delicious — not obvious AI slop.



Tools You’ll Use



- Higgsfield  

- Claude  

- JSON prompts / structured prompt formats  

- Google Drive or similar file organization  

- Social media reference videos for style and quality  

- If you can edit, probably CapCut and Primere Pro 



We will provide training, examples, recipes, prompts, and guidance.



You Might Be a Great Fit If



- You spend more time watching recipe videos than you’d like to admit.

- You can instantly tell when a food video looks realistic and appetizing.

- You enjoy experimenting with AI tools and learning new workflows.

- You notice small details that other people miss.

- You like flexible, output-based work that fits around your existing schedule.

- You’re looking for a side hustle rather than another full-time commitment.

- You already have VA, editing, social media, or content creation experience.

- You care about making food look genuinely delicious, not just “technically correct.”

- You are comfortable following structured instructions, prompts, and JSON formatting.

- You are patient enough to regenerate or adjust clips until they look right.

- You understand that tiny visual details matter: weird hands, fake steam, bad textures, unnatural sauce, distorted pans, or food that does not match the recipe.

- You want to grow with a brand where strong performance can lead to higher pay, bonuses, upside opportunities, and more consistent work as sales increase.

- You have long-term vision and understand that early-stage opportunities can grow into much bigger income once the brand gains traction.



Requirements



- **Strong attention to detail**  

- Good visual taste for food content  

- Ability to follow step-by-step instructions  

- Willingness to learn AI video tools  

- Comfortable using Claude or ChatGPT-style tools  

- Comfortable working with JSON or willing to learn  

- Reliable communication  

- Ability to deliver organized files on time  

- Interest in food, cooking, recipes, or short-form content  

- Editing experience is a huge plus  

- Must be able to accept feedback and make revisions  



Experience with AI video tools is helpful, but not required. We care more about your eye for quality, your ability to learn, and your ability to produce clips that look realistic, delicious, and usable for short-form content. And your ability to be consistent day in and day out to show up and perform and learn. 



Pay



This is output-based freelance work and should be viewed as a flexible side hustle with growth potential.



- $10 per completed batch of video clips per recipe

- $5 for edits/revision batches. (Since it is AI clips, the editing is minimal. Adding text and music and trimming clips for a ~35 second video)

- Pay includes the opportunity for performance bonuses

- Strong performers may also participate in upside through bonuses

- As sales and content performance increase, there will be opportunities for larger pay, higher bonuses, and more consistent work

- The goal is for pay to increase significantly as the brand gains traction, especially for people who help build the system early and consistently deliver great work



How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short message about why you are interested  

2. Any experience with AI tools, video editing, food content, VA work, or social media  

3. 1–3 examples of food videos or short-form content you think look high-quality and explain why. If you don't have, explain a scenario where you were consistent even when the results did not show up how you wanted

4. Your availability each week  

5. Confirm that you understand this is output-based side-hustle work with long-term upside: $10 per recipe clip batch and $5 for edits, with performance bonuses and upside opportunities as the brand grows  



Bonus points if you already watch recipe reels, TikToks, or food content and can explain what makes a clip look realistic, appetizing, and engaging. Send us your favorite food creator or a video you like.
salary: $10 per video clip batch and $5 per edit

title: AI Social Media Content Creator
description:
# AI Social Media Content Creator / AI Video Creator



We are looking for a driven AI Social Media Content Creator who wants to become truly excellent at creating AI-generated short-form video content.



This is not a “do the bare minimum and turn something in” role. We are looking for someone who takes pride in the details, cares about the final outcome, and wants to keep improving until the content is actually good.



The right person for this role is creative, organized, diligent, and honest. You should care about doing clean work, following instructions, solving problems, and making content that performs better over time.



## About The Role



You will help create AI-generated social media videos for different brands. The goal of the content is to get views, engagement, and attention from the right audience for each brand.



You will be working with AI tools to help create short-form videos for platforms like Instagram Reels, TikTok, and similar platforms. This includes coming up with content ideas, writing or improving scripts, generating realistic AI images, turning those images into videos, editing the clips together, adding captions, creating hooks, and helping prepare the final video for posting.



This role is for someone who wants to get really good at AI content creation, not someone who is just looking for an easy task list.



## What You’ll Be Doing



You will help with tasks such as:



Creating content ideas based on each brand’s ideal customer profile.



Studying what kind of content performs well and using that to create better video ideas.



Writing, organizing, or improving short-form video scripts and storyboards.



Finding reference videos or images to help guide realistic AI-generated content.



Creating AI-generated images using approved model photos, brand details, locations, outfits, and references.



Making sure AI avatars look realistic, consistent, and natural over time.



Creating image-to-video prompts for tools like Kling.



Reviewing AI-generated clips and identifying what looks real versus what looks obviously AI-generated.



Editing videos so they feel tight, natural, and engaging.



Removing dead space, awkward pauses, bad clips, or anything that hurts the quality of the video.



Adding hooks, captions, subtitles, and text that are easy to read on mobile.



Making sure videos are formatted correctly for vertical social media.



Posting content to the correct social media accounts when needed.



Saving and organizing scripts, images, clips, and final videos in the correct folders.



## What We Care About Most



We care about quality, effort, and character.



We are not looking for someone who rushes through tasks, ignores details, or turns in messy work just to say it is done.



We want someone who:



Reads instructions carefully.



Watches training videos when provided.



Double-checks their work before submitting it.



Asks smart questions when something is unclear.



Takes ownership of the final result.



Cares about making the video better, not just “finished.”



Notices small details that make AI content look fake.



Understands that clean organization matters.



Has integrity and tells the truth if something went wrong.



Is willing to learn, improve, and work harder to create a better outcome.



## This Is A Good Fit If You Are



Someone who wants to become one of the best at creating AI social media content.



Creative, but also organized.



Detail-oriented and willing to follow a process.



Comfortable learning new AI tools.



Interested in social media, short-form video, marketing, hooks, and content strategy.



Willing to study what works and improve over time.



Good at spotting when something looks fake, awkward, or low-quality.



Able to work independently without needing to be reminded about every detail.



Proud of doing work the right way.



The kind of person who would rather fix something than turn in something messy.



## This Is Not A Good Fit If You



Only want easy copy-and-paste tasks.



Skip instructions.



Turn in unfinished or sloppy work.



Use AI tools without reviewing the output.



Say something is done when it clearly needs more work.



Do not like feedback.



Get annoyed by details.



Need constant reminders to stay organized.



Are not interested in improving your skill.



Do not care whether the final video is actually good.



## Skills That Are Helpful



Experience with AI image or video tools is helpful, but not required if you are a fast learner.



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



AI image generation.



AI video generation.



Short-form video editing.



Instagram Reels or TikTok content.



Writing hooks or captions.



Social media content strategy.



Canva, CapCut, Clipchamp, or other editing tools.



ChatGPT prompting.



Organizing creative files and project folders.



Studying viral content and adapting it for different brands.



## The Standard We Expect



Every video should be treated like it matters.



That means the script should make sense, the visuals should match the concept, the AI model should look realistic, the video should be edited tightly, the captions should be readable, and the final version should feel like something a real person would stop and watch.



You do not need to be perfect on day one. But you do need to care, learn fast, and take pride in improving.



## Why This Role Is Valuable



AI content creation is becoming one of the most important skills in marketing. This role gives you the chance to get hands-on experience creating real AI-generated content for real brands.



You will learn how to think about audience psychology, hooks, content ideas, AI visuals, video structure, editing, and posting. Over time, the goal is for you to become someone who can take a content idea and turn it into a strong finished video with minimal help.



## How To Apply



Please apply only if you are serious about doing high-quality work.



In your application, tell us:



Why you want to get good at AI social media content creation.



What makes you detail-oriented.



An example of a time you worked harder than expected to create a better result.



Any experience you have with AI tools, video editing, social media, or content creation.



Why you believe integrity matters when working remotely.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow into this skill, take ownership, and become excellent at creating AI social media content.

title: Brand Design & TikTok Content Specialist for Cosmetics Startup
description:
We are building a cosmetics/skincare brand using white-label products and are looking for a creative, fast, and commercially-minded person to help us test multiple brand concepts.



This role is not just graphic design. We need someone who can think like a brand builder, understand packaging, create strong social media content, and help us test which product concepts have the best chance of selling through Shopify and TikTok Shop.



You will help us create different brand/concept ideas, including product packaging designs, Shopify visuals, TikTok content ideas, social media posts, and advertising creatives. The goal is to test multiple concepts quickly, identify the most promising ones, and then scale the winning brand.



##Responsibilities



* Create cosmetic/skincare brand concepts from scratch

* Design product packaging concepts for white-label skincare/cosmetic products

* Create clean, premium-looking product labels and mockups

* Build visual directions for different brand ideas, including colors, fonts, layout, and overall aesthetic

* Create social media content ideas for TikTok, Instagram, and TikTok Shop

* Help plan viral-style TikTok content angles, hooks, scripts, and ad creatives

* Support Shopify store design, product page layout, banners, and brand visuals

* Research competitor skincare/cosmetic brands and identify design/content trends

* Help us test different concepts quickly and improve based on feedback



##Ideal Candidate



You should have experience with some or most of the following:



* Beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or ecommerce brand design

* Packaging design, label design, or product mockups

* Canva, Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, or similar tools

* Shopify store design or ecommerce product page design

* TikTok, Instagram Reels, short-form video content, or UGC-style content

* Social media ad creatives and viral content strategy

* Branding for startups or direct-to-consumer ecommerce brands



You do not need to be perfect at everything, but you must be smart, reactive, creative, and willing to move fast.



## Important Qualities



We are looking for someone who is:



* Creative but also practical

* Fast at producing concepts

* Good at taking feedback

* Able to research trends independently

* Interested in ecommerce, TikTok Shop, and beauty brands

* Good at testing ideas instead of overthinking everything

* Reliable, organised, and proactive

* Able to communicate clearly in English



## First Test Project



Before hiring full-time, we would like to start with a paid test project.



For the first concept, we may ask you to create:



* 1 skincare/cosmetic brand concept

* 1 logo or brand direction

* 1 product label/packaging concept

* 2–3 product mockups

* 3 TikTok content ideas or ad angles

* 3 social media post concepts

* Basic Shopify product page design direction



If the test project is strong, we would like to hire the right person full-time.



## To Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your portfolio link

3. Examples of beauty, skincare, packaging, ecommerce, Shopify, or social media work

4. Your experience with TikTok, TikTok Shop, Shopify, or ecommerce brands

5. The design/content tools you use

6. Your expected monthly full-time salary

7. Your availability and how soon you can start



Please start your application with the word “SKINCARE” so we know you read the full post.



We are looking for someone long-term who can grow with the business. If you are creative, fast, and understand how to make brands look good and sell online, we would like to hear from you.

title: Fashion Stylist Assistant — Wardrobe Sourcing & Styling
description:
Job Title: Fashion Stylist Assistant — Wardrobe Sourcing & Styling Support (Part-Time, Remote)

About the role



I'm a personal stylist and image coach with a growing client roster, and I'm looking for a talented stylist assistant to help me source and build out client wardrobes. I map out each client's direction — coloring, silhouettes, proportions, the specific pieces they need — and you bring it to life by finding the right items online and helping complete cohesive outfits.



This isn't data-entry sourcing. It requires a real eye: an understanding of color, fit, body types, and how pieces work together. Some clients I'll hand you a precise list to fill; others I'll give you a looser map and want your ideas. 

You should be comfortable with both.

The goal is to take the time-heavy sourcing work off my plate so I can focus on strategy and take on more clients. For the right person, this is a long-term, growing role.

What you'll do



-Source specific pieces I've mapped out for clients (e.g., "a longer A-line skirt in a muted earth tone," "long-sleeve knits in X palette") by searching online retailers

-Work from a brand/retailer list I provide (primarily US-based, but not exclusively) — and intelligently find comparable pieces elsewhere when needed

-Complete outfits by filling gaps in a client's wardrobe with pieces that work together in color, proportion, and style

-Build moodboards that capture a client's direction and proposed looks

-Contribute ideas when invited — for some clients I'll want your styling suggestions, not just execution

Stay organized across multiple clients and keep sourcing options clearly presented (links, images, notes on why each works)



Who I'm looking for



-Trained/experienced stylist — please share a resume, portfolio, or examples of styling work

-Strong grasp of color theory, body types/proportions, and fit



-A genuine eye and point of view — creative, with good instincts about what works



-Able to follow direction precisely when I give a specific brief, and contribute thoughtfully when I open the floor



-Resourceful and fast at finding pieces online; knows how to search well and dig past the obvious



-Familiar with US fashion retail (or able to learn a brand list quickly)



-Reliable, communicative, works independently once briefed



Hours & Rate



Part-time to start, ~10–15 hrs/week, with room to grow as my client load grows

RATE BASED ON EXPERIENCE— tell me your rate when you apply (IM HAPPY TO PAY WELL FOR EXPERTISE)

Long-term role; performance raises and year-end bonus for the right fit



To apply, please answer:



send me your portfolio plus your Instagram and/or Pinterest



-Tell me about your styling background — share a resume, portfolio, or links to work you're proud of.

-How do you think about dressing different body types? Give me an example of styling for a specific shape.

-Where do you shop/source online, and how do you find a specific piece when the obvious searches don't turn it up?



Paid Test Task (paid for your time):



I'll give you a short client brief — coloring, body type, and 2–3 specific pieces I need sourced. You'll:



-Source each piece — send me 2–3 options per item with links, images, and one line on why each works

-Build a simple moodboard for the client's direction

-Suggest one piece I didn't ask for that would complete the look, and tell me why



This shows me your eye, your sourcing skill, and whether you can both follow a brief and think for yourself.

title: Property Deal Analyst - Full Time
description:
We're a UK property company. We find rental property deals, analyse them, and either manage them ourselves or pass them to investors.



There's a steady flow of potential deals coming in every day, and someone needs to go through them properly and tell us which ones are worth our time.



It's careful, focused, repetitive work - and done well, it's one of the most important roles in the business, because everything we do starts with finding good deals and filtering out bad ones.



We're looking for someone who is genuinely good at careful, detailed analysis, takes pride in getting it right, and wants a stable role they can settle into for the long term.





Every day, you will:



Find potential deals :

Search specific
 groups and other online sources where property deals get posted.



Filter them (first pass):

Run each one against a clear set of pass/fail rules we'll give you. Most deals fail here - that's normal and correct. Your job is to kill the obvious "no" deals quickly so they never reach us.



Analyse the survivors (deep dive):

For the deals that pass the first filter, you'll do a proper analysis: pull the numbers, find comparable properties, check the competition, and fill out a deal analysis sheet we'll provide.



Give a verdict:

For each analysed deal, you'll give us a clear thumbs up or thumbs down - "this is a good deal" or "this isn't" - with your reasoning. We make the final call, but your verdict is what we act on, so it has to be sound.



Keep everything organised: 

Log each deal in our system so nothing slips through the cracks.



You will not be talking to landlords, negotiating, or closing deals. That's our side. Your job is the analysis and the verdict - and doing it accurately, every day, at good volume.





You'll do well here if you:



Can form a sound judgement on numbers. This is the heart of the job. You'll be d
 whether a deal is actually good, and we act on your verdict. 



We need someone who can look at the figures and think clearly about whether they really stack up - who can tell a genuinely good deal from one that's just been dressed up to look good. This is not copy-and-paste data entry.



Stay consistent, so deal number 40 gets the same care as deal number 1. You don't get sloppy when you're tired or bored. 



You hit your daily targets without being chased, and a cleared list done correctly gives you genuine satisfaction.



Catch the small things. A wrong comparable, a transposed number, a missing field - you notice it. In this work, small errors lead to wrong verdicts, so getting the details right the first time matters.



Want this role for the long term. You're looking for a stable, steady job you can hold for years - not a stepping stone to something else.



Have reliable power and internet. This work happens on a daily schedule, so you need a stable setup where you can work consistently without long outages.





Please don't apply if you:



Are looking for a short-term gig or a stepping stone while you pursue something else - studying full-time, planning to move abroad, building your own business on the side. This role needs your full focus and a long-term commitment.



Get bored easily by repetitive, detail-heavy work. This job is the same careful process every day. If that sounds dull to you, you'll be unhappy here and so will we.



You do not need any property or real estate experience - we'll train you on everything property-related. We're hiring for temperament and analytical ability, not property knowledge.





How to apply



There's a link below to complete the application form for this role. This is the only way your application will be processed.



You'll also need to attach a short Loom video of yourself within the application form, introducing yourself further. 



If you don't submit the Loom video, you will not be considered for this role

title: Short Form Video Editor
description:
Short Form Video Editor (Full-Time, Remote) - Z Prime Media



Pay: $5/hour, USD

Hours: 30-40 hours/week (varies by production cycle, trending toward consistent 40 as we scale)

Type: Full-time, independent contractor

Start: Immediate



About Us



Z Prime Media (ZPM) is a video marketing agency based in Michigan, USA. We produce short-form vertical video content for healthcare clients (dental and physical therapy practices), turning their expertise into talking-head videos for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube,
, and LinkedIn. We're a small, fast-moving team, and we care more about quality than volume. We're looking for a dedicated full-time editor to join us long term, not just to fill a seat.



For a sense of our team's production background, our founder previously built What's Up Metro Detroit 
 a local media brand that hit roughly 1 million views in its first four months. That's a different style and a different company, but it gives you a sense of the level we operate at.



The Role



You'll be editing short-form vertical video content for multiple clients every month. This is editing only, no scheduling, posting, or client communication required.



We're not looking for someone to just execute a checklist. We have a general house style (hooks, pacing, captions, branding) but we want to see your editing instincts and style, and we want you to help shape how our content evolves, not just replicate what we already do.



This is a quality-focused role, but quality and efficiency go hand in hand here. We need someone who can deliver genuinely good work at a pace that holds up across a full monthly client load.



Collaboration, Not Just Execution



This isn't a "deliverables in, deliverables out" position. We want a real creative collaborator: someone with opinions on shooting techniques, editing styles, pacing, trends, and content angles, and who actively brings ideas to the table as we grow. Your input matters to us.



For the right person, this can grow into a senior editor role overseeing other editors as we scale.



What We Need From You





Strong editing skills and a great eye for pacing, hooks, and short-form content that performs. We use CapCut, but Adobe Premiere or similar is fine, we'll provide a subscription to whichever tool we land on, no need to already own one

A willingness to bring your own ideas and opinions to the table on editing style, shooting techniques, and content strategy, not just execute instructions

A genuine commitment to quality, delivered efficiently across a full monthly workload

Strong, reliable communication, responsive during work hours and proactive about flagging issues

Comfortable with a high-output monthly schedule across multiple clients

Reliable internet and equipment for daily editing work





What We Offer





Stable, ongoing work (not project-based or one-off gigs), with hours growing toward a consistent 40/week as we add clients

A real voice in how we shoot, edit, and create, not just a list of instructions to follow

Long-term growth potential into a senior editor role leading a small team





How to Apply



Please apply with your resume and a portfolio of your previous editing work (short-form/social content preferred).



Important: Include the words "I am thorough" in the subject line of your application. Applications without this will not be reviewed.



After an initial interview, shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a short paid take-home test (editing one sample video two different ways) before a final decision is made.

Designing and building automations in n8n (multi-step workflows, error handling, webhooks, custom logic)

Connecting LLMs (Claude, OpenAI, OpenRouter) into real workflows via our AI gateway

Building and refining AI agents to handle support, admin, reconciliation and reporting tasks

Comfortable with LLM APIs and prompt engineering

Some scripting ability (Python or JavaScript) — enough to write custom functions and parse JSON

Understands webhooks, REST APIs and authentication

Excellent written English and clear spoken English

Reliable, self-managing, and genuinely curious about AI

2. A short voice recording (1–2 minutes). Record yourself (phone is fine — use a free tool like 
) answering:

title: Short-Form Video Editor / Clipper — Viral Reels & TikToks (High Volume, Ongoing)
description:
READ THIS FIRST — to filter yourself in or out:



The #1 reason a short-form video gets scrolled past in the first 1 second is __________.



Answer that in 2-3 sentences from your OWN editing experience (NOT ChatGPT, NOT a template). If you can't, this role isn't for you — I'll skip applications that don't lead with that answer.



If your application starts with "I am a passionate and dedicated video editor with excellent skills" — I will skip it. I want one specific kind of editor, not a stock cover letter.



---



We're a New Zealand AI-powered marketing agency. We grow businesses and creators on short-form video (Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts), and we're producing a HIGH volume of content — aiming for ~10 finished videos per day across a small team of editors.



We're hiring SEVERAL short-form editors / clippers at once. We send you raw footage + a clear brief, you cut it into dynamic, retention-led short-form videos in the style of the best creators online. Fast turnaround, ongoing work, room to take on more videos (and more pay) as you prove out.



THE STYLE WE WANT — study these before applying:

- WATCH OUR FIRST EDITED VIDEO — this is the exact standard + style you'll be matching: 

- Devin Jatho 
 is our north star for editing style. Watch a few of his videos before you apply.

- Fast, dynamic cuts. Punchy 1-second hooks. Clean animated captions. Zooms, pattern interrupts, B-roll, sound design that lands on the beat.

- Modern, high-retention, "scroll-stopping" — NOT slow corporate edits, NOT cheesy sound-effect spam.

- We'll send the raw footage + a per-project brief so you know exactly what to cut.



WHAT THESE VIDEOS ARE FOR:

The content promotes our Social Growth Plan — 
 — a done-for-you content-strategy product for creators and founders. You'll be editing videos built to grow our audience and drive viewers to that page, so every edit needs to hold attention to the very end and land the call-to-action cleanly.



WHAT YOU'LL DO:

- Receive raw clips + a written brief (hook, beats, on-screen text, pacing notes, reference)

- Cut 9:16 vertical short-form videos to a viral standard

- Animated captions, on-screen text, trending-audio sync, tight pacing, clean exports

- Turn videos around fast — this is a volume role; ideally you can do 2+ per day

- Keep a consistent style across videos while adapting per brief



WHAT YOU NEED TO BE GOOD AT:

- Short-form editing in CapCut and/or Premiere Pro / After Effects (DaVinci fine)

- Hook-first retention editing — you understand WHY a video holds attention, not just making it pretty

- Clean animated captions + on-screen text (accurate, well-timed, on-brand)

- Working fast to a brief without quality dropping

- Clear English communication and reliable turnaround



NICE TO HAVE:

- Reusable caption / motion-graphics templates

- A feel for what's trending on Reels / TikTok right now

- Experience editing founder-led / talking-head + B-roll content



THE SETUP:

- Per-video pay (you quote your rate). Ongoing volume — the better and faster you are, the more videos we send you.

- Paid test edit: we send one set of raw clips + a brief, you return one finished short. We pay $5 USD for the test regardless of outcome.

- This is a real, ongoing role with room to grow into more videos/day and a higher per-video rate as you prove out.



HOW TO APPLY — send these THREE things, in this order:



1. Your 2-3 sentence answer to: "The #1 reason a short-form video gets scrolled past in the first 1 second is ___" (your own experience, not ChatGPT)



2. 2-3 short-form videos YOU personally edited — DIRECT video links (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, or specific Drive/Dropbox FILE links — NOT folders, NOT showreels).



3. Your per-video rate (USD) + how many videos per day you can realistically deliver.



I reply within 48 hours and pay $5 USD for a short test edit if your samples fit.



WHAT I WILL NOT REPLY TO:

- Agency
s ("we are a team of 50 editors")

- Drive-folder portfolios (send direct video links only)

- Editors who only do gaming / wedding / long-form vlog content

- Anyone whose answer to question 1 reads like ChatGPT

- Anyone who applies without watching a few Devin Jatho videos first

This is a senior execution role for someone who loves turning strategy and Loom videos into well run projects and functioning GoHighLevel systems, not a “figure out our business from scratch” role.

About The Role

You will manage projects from idea to launch, coordinating with the founder and any contractors, while building, maintaining, and improving our GoHighLevel funnels, automations, and pipelines. You’ll thrive if you enjoy keeping a lot of moving pieces organized, documenting as you go, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.

We already have offers, strategies, and templates; your job is to execute, refine, and keep launches on track, not to invent everything from zero.



Key Responsibilities

• Turn high-level ideas and Loom instructions into clear, actionable task lists and project plans in our PM tool.

• Build and update GoHighLevel funnels, pipelines, automations, forms, calendars, and
/SMS campaigns using our existing strategies and templates.

• Own launch timelines: coordinate tasks, track progress, follow up with stakeholders, and ensure milestones are hit on time.

• Coordinate with the founder and contractors (copy, design, tech) to ensure deliverables are completed accurately and on schedule.

• Perform thorough QA on funnels and automations before launch so tags, triggers,
s, SMS, and calendars all function correctly.

• Document processes and build simple SOPs as we go, so projects become easier and faster to repeat over time.

• Monitor basic performance metrics in GHL (pipeline movement, show-up rates, contact flow) and flag issues or opportunities for improvement.



Ideal Candidate Profile

You are an organized, proactive operator who enjoys working inside GoHighLevel daily and being the person who keeps everything moving. You pride yourself on reliability, follow through, and being able to take a Loom and quietly get the job done without hand holding.



You have:

• Minimum 5 years experience in project management, operations, or a similar role in online/digital businesses.

• At least 2–3 years hands-on experience inside GoHighLevel (or a very similar CRM/automation platform) building funnels, automations, and appointment pipelines.

• Proven experience turning ideas and voice/video notes into structured tasks, timelines, and well-documented processes.

• Strong attention to detail and the habit of QA’ing your own work before asking for review.

• Clear written English and confidence communicating asynchronously via Slack,
, and Loom.

• Comfort working remotely, managing your own time, and staying accountable to deadlines and outcomes.



Nice to have (not required):

• Experience building funnels and simple landing pages using templates (no custom coding needed).

• Understanding of sales pipelines, lead nurture sequences, and appointment booking flows.

• Familiarity with Google Sheets or similar tools to track simple metrics and task lists.



Tools You’ll Use

• GoHighLevel – for funnels, automations, CRM, and calendars.

• A project management tool (Trello, ClickUp, or similar) – for tasks, timelines, and launch tracking.

• Slack and Loom – for communication, updates, and video walkthroughs.

• Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive) – for documentation and tracking.



Working Style & Hours

• Remote role with flexible hours, as long as agreed deadlines are met and there is some overlap with [insert your primary time zone] for communication.

• Part-time to start (e.g., X–Y hours per week), with potential to increase hours and responsibility as we grow if it’s a strong fit.



Compensation

• Clear opportunities to grow into a more senior operations or project leadership role over time for the right person.



How To Apply

Please apply with:

• 1–3 brief examples (screenshots or Looms) of funnels and automations you’ve personally built or managed (blur or hide sensitive info).

• Explain, in simple terms, what GoHighLevel is and how you’ve used it in past roles.

• Walk through your understanding of funnel building and a basic automation flow (e.g., lead capture ? nurture ? booking).

• Give a quick overview of one funnel or automation you’ve set up before.

• Your expected hourly rate or monthly retainer and your typical weekly availability.

- Application Assistance: Guide clients through the technical process of applying for social security, disability benefits, healthcare subsidies, or vocational training grants.

- Goal Tracking: Regularly interview clients to monitor the effectiveness of provided resources and pivot strategies if a particular resource is no longer a fit.

- Problem-Solving: Proactive approach to finding creative solutions for clients with limited access to traditional support systems.

title: Full Time for Copywriter For Personal Brand
description:
# Instagram copywriter 



We're Digital Wealth Lab. We teach corporate people how to start AI marketing agencies for local businesses, and Bruno's Instagram is where most of that audience comes from. The account works because we skip the guru theater and just show the actual system. We need a writer who can keep it that way while we post more.



This is social copy. Not
, not landing pages, not blogs. If that's your portfolio you're probably great at it, but you're not who we're after. We want someone who has run an IG account for real: written the carousels and reels, watched what saved and what died, and figured out why.



## The job



Daily carousels for Bruno, reels later once you've got the voice down. You draft with our AI system to move fast, then rewrite it line by line until it's actually good. The AI gets you a draft. You write the post.



- Carousels now, reels soon, all in Bruno's voice

- Hooks that stop the scroll, CTAs that get DMs

- QA every post against the voice, the format specs, and our guidelines

- Brief the designers and editors so nobody's guessing

- Track what hits, what flops, what gets flagged, and fix the system off it

- Own the lead and growth numbers from organic



## Who we want



Not entry level. This is for someone already good at social who wants a bigger seat: real numbers, daily output, a small team, and a say in how the whole thing runs.



You should have:



- Written for influencers, coaches, or personal brands. Bonus if it's biz-op, finance, or self-improvement.

- Run an actual Instagram account day to day. Carousels, reels, captions, timing.

- Copy you'd defend. You can pull a reader from slide one to the CTA, and you know a good hook from a bad one without calling a meeting about it.

- A marketer's eye. Look at a post and tell us whether it's built to grow, to capture leads, or to sell.

- AI already in your workflow. You prompt Claude or GPT, you call out a weak draft, and you never ship the first thing it hands you.



Nice if you've got: theme page or shoutout experience, an info-product or high-ticket background, work for a 100k+ creator, funnels that turn attention into calls or sales, or ghostwriting in someone else's voice.



## Two things we won't budge on



The voice is Bruno's. If you'd rather write like yourself, you'll hate this.



Hours are 4 AM to 12 PM Eastern, Monday to Friday.



## How to apply



No test task, no consideration. Finish the whole thing and you'll hear back either way.



**1. Five-minute video.** Loom or whatever you've got. Who you are, why this role, why you, how you use AI, and anything you've written for creators or brands.



**2. The task.**



Part 1: Go through Bruno's profile (
), research the account, and pitch 5 post ideas (hook plus a short outline). No need to write the full posts.



Example:



> Hook: At 20 I was making $52k at a 9-5. I failed 6 businesses over the next 4 years. Everyone thought I was done. Then one boring AI tool changed everything.

>

> Outline: Bruno's story and the exact system he ran, with real numbers, named tools, and the math (what the tool costs vs. what the client pays).



Part 2: Write the full carousel for 2 of your 5 ideas. Draft with AI if you want, but we're paying for your writing, so the final words are yours. If you used AI, send the transcript too.



You get 24 to 48 hours once we send the task over.



Send us the video, your 5 ideas, the 2 carousels, and the transcript if there is one.

description:
We are a Swiss performance marketing agency serving French-speaking businesses (SMEs). We build high-converting websites, landing pages, and e-commerce stores — not templates, not cookie-cutter sites. Every project must look custom, feel premium, and convert.



We're looking for a key tea
mber to own the web delivery process: from wireframe to finished site. You will receive brand direction and conversion goals. Your job is to turn that into a pixel-perfect, mobile-first website — design, copy, and build — that looks and performs at a premium level.



This is not a job for someone who drags and drops Starter Templates and calls it done.



This is a full-time, dedicated position. We are NOT looking for freelancers, part-timers, or project-based workers. You work exclusively with us — no side clients, no splitting your time. If you're looking for a gig or a side project, this is not it.



If you currently work for another employer or agency — do not apply. We need someone 100% available and 100% committed from day one. This is not a "second job."





What You'll Build



Business websites (5–30 pages) with strong visual hierarchy and conversion architecture

Landing pages optimized for Google Ads and Meta Ads traffic

WooCommerce stores with product catalogs, filtering, custom single/archive templates

Elementor Pro templates with dynamic content, custom loops, and clean responsive design

Speed-optimized pages (Core Web Vitals green across the board)



All client-facing content is in French. You don't need to be a native speaker — you can use AI tools to assist. But you MUST understand three disciplines:



Copywriting — You know what makes a headline work, how to stack benefits, how to handle objections in text, and how to write a CTA that earns the click. You can write hero sections, subheads, body text, and product descriptions that sell.



Design — You understand visual hierarchy, whitespace, typography, contrast, and layout patterns. You build pages that guide the eye and feel intentional on every device.



Conversion & CRO — You know WHY elements are placed where they are. Above the fold, trust signals, social proof, urgency — you think in terms of what makes a visitor take action, not just what looks nice.



If you don't understand all three, this role is not for you — please don't apply. You don't need to be an expert in everything, but you need to get how these work together and be willing to sharpen your skills using AI tools every single day.



French copy must read naturally — AI-assisted is fine, but the output must feel like a native wrote it. We review, we give feedback, we refine together. But you bring the first draft, not us.





Hard Requirements (Non-Negotiable)



You must have minimum 3–5 years of proven, professional experience and demonstrated portfolio results in ALL of the following:



Elementor Pro — Advanced. Custom widgets, theme builder (header/footer/single/archive), motion effects, custom CSS, responsive editing across all breakpoints. Not just "I know Elementor."



WooCommerce — Full store builds. Product setup, variable products, category architecture, custom templates for shop/single/archive, payment gateway integration, shipping configuration.



Visual Design & Layout Hierarchy — You understand whitespace, typography pairing, visual weight, F-pattern/Z-pattern scanning, CTA placement, contrast ratios. You can look at a design and KNOW what's wrong before being told.



CSS & Light PHP — You can write custom CSS without Googling every property. You can modify a 
p snippet. You understand child themes.



Page Speed Optimization — Image optimization (WebP/AVIF), lazy loading, font optimization, plugin audit, caching configuration. You know what render-blocking means and how to fix it.



Mobile-First Responsive Design — Not "it works on mobile." It must LOOK intentional on mobile. Custom breakpoint adjustments, touch-friendly UI, no horizontal scrolling, no overlapping elements.



SEO Fundamentals — Proper heading hierarchy (H1?H2?H3), alt tags, internal linking structure, schema markup awareness, clean URL structure.



AI-Powered Workflow — You actively use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar) to accelerate your work: drafting copy, generating layouts, debugging code, optimizing images, researching competitors. You don't just "know about AI" — you use it daily and it makes you faster. If you're still doing everything manually, you're too slow for this role.



GA4 & Tracking Integration — You can set up Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking, and event configuration. You understand how pixels work (Meta, Google Ads), how to verify they fire correctly, and how to debug tracking issues.

Direct Slack/Telegram communication — no micromanagement, no pointless meetings

Long-term stability — this is not a project gig, this is a partnership

Pixel-perfect execution. If something is 3px off, you notice it before we do.

Proactive communication. If something is unclear, you ask BEFORE building the wrong thing.

Speed without sloppiness. A standard business website (8–12 pages) should take you 5–7 working days from brief to delivery, not 3 weeks.

Quiet workspace for video calls
