Clear salary milestones based on performance, not time:

Start: $600–$750/month

6 months (KPIs met): $900–$1,000/month

12 months (consistent performance): $1,200+/month + project bonuses



We also offer project-based bonuses for fast, high-quality delivery.



After 3 months: 10 paid vacation days per year (2 weeks — aligned with European standards). Philippine public holidays observed.



Paid via Wise or PayPal. Full-time (40 hrs/week), flexible schedule within reason. We care about output, not clock-watching. But you must be available for real-time communication during at least 4 overlapping hours with Central European Time (CET).



We're not looking for someone chasing the highest paycheck today. We're looking for someone hungry, skilled, and ready to grow into a Design & Build Project Manager role as the agency scales — leading projects, managing timelines, and owning client delivery end to end.





First 30 Days — What Success Looks Like



These are the expectations for your first month. If you meet them, you're in the right place. If not, we part ways — no hard feelings, but no second chances.



Deliver your first complete website (8–12 pages) within 7 working days of receiving the brief

Respond to messages within 2 hours during overlapping CET hours

Deliver mobile-responsive pages that require zero revision on responsiveness

Demonstrate autonomous problem-solving: research, d
, build — then ask for review, not instructions

Show you can write French copy that needs minor corrections, not rewrites





Confidentiality & NDA



You will have access to proprietary tools, client data, internal processes, and agency strategies. Before starting, you will sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement.



This is non-negotiable. Everything you see, build, or learn inside this agency stays inside this agency. Sharing client information, internal tools, workflows, or strategies with anyone — including other employers or clients — is grounds for immediate termination.





Terms



2-week notice period from either side

All work produced during employment is the property of the agency

All client access (WordPress, hosting, tools) will be revoked upon termination

If performance expectations are not met within the first 30 days, employment ends immediately with payment for days worked





HOW TO APPLY — FOLLOW THESE STEPS EXACTLY



Applications that don't follow ALL steps below will be automatically rejected.



Step 1 — Subject Line

Your message subject must be exactly:

"BUILDER-2026 — [Your First Name]"

What Happens Next

title: NOW HIRING — Operations Manager / Social Media Lead
description:
# NOW HIRING — Operations Manager / Social Media Lead

### Full-Time · Remote · Patrick Capital Group LLC (The Outcast Investor + BrandFromFaceless)



*Read this all the way through. The instructions matter — we'll explain why at the bottom.*



---



## Who we are



We build brands that help first-generation men build real wealth and break the cycle for their families. We run **multiple brands at once** — The Outcast Investor (real estate + mindset) and BrandFromFaceless (faceless online business for skilled tradesmen) — with more coming. We move fast, we build in public, and we're scaling.



The founder is the **Visionary** — the face, the message, the direction. We need someone to **own the Operations Function** so he can stay there.



---



## The role



This is **not** a "post pretty graphics" job. This is an **operator** role with a social-media-ops core. You will run the day-to-day machine across multiple brands and **own the outcomes** — not just the tasks.



You'll be the person who turns vision into execution: building systems, managing the team, and making sure the numbers move. If you've run multiple brands at once and built teams that deliver, this is for you.



---



## What you'll own



- **Run social media operations** across multiple brands — content calendars, scheduling, posting cadence, community management, and making sure nothing drops.

- **Manage and build the team.** We already have contractors (funnel builder, content editors, social manager). You'll coordinate them, hold them to deadlines, hire and onboard new help as we grow, and keep everyone moving toward the same goals.

- **Own the systems.** Build and maintain SOPs so the machine runs without the founder in every detail. If something breaks twice, you build a system so it never breaks a third time.

- **Own the numbers.** You'll be accountable to clear monthly KPIs — leads, sales, audience growth. You don't just do activity; you drive results and report on them.

- **Keep the trains running.** Weekly priorities, daily execution, nothing slips through the cracks. You are the calm in the chaos.



---



## How we work (read this carefully)



- We run on an **AI-powered operating system.** As part of the team, you'll have access to our internal AI workspace (Claude Team), where a lot of our strategy, SOPs, content systems, and planning live. You'll use it daily as your operations engine — drafting plans, building SOPs, organizing the team's work, and tracking KPIs.

- **The flow is simple:** the founder sets the vision and the priorities ? you turn those into the operational plan and execution (using the tools and AI at your disposal) ? the team executes under you. The founder stays the Visionary; you run the operation.

- **You'll have team access to the tools you need to do the job** — *not* master logins or any payment/financial credentials. We protect those, and we'll never ask you to handle them.



---

 hours

We are looking for a highly disciplined, hyper-focused Virtual Assistant to help prepare, warm up, and manage new YouTube channels assets. Your job is to train the algorithm to recognize a new account as a trustworthy, high-value, real human user based in the United States.



This is **not** a standard data-entry job. It requires mimicking natural, erratic human browsing behavior while strictly following anti-detect protocols. If you are someone who naturally notices the small details and can follow a strict protocol without taking shortcuts, this is for you.

s, sign up for select US newsletters, upload casual files to Google Drive, set up calendar events, create custom YouTube playlists, and leave genuine, high-quality comments on niche videos.

Because this role requires mimicking a real person living in the USA, your working hours **must match US Time



- **Daily Time Commitment:** ~3 hours per day** 

    

- **Timing Window:** You must complete your session during NY daytime or evening hours (**9:00 AM to 10:00 PM USA Time**).

    

- **Your Local Time (Philippine Time):** This translates to **9:00 PM to 10:00 AM PHT**.

    

- **Flexibility:** You do not have to work the exact same hours every day. In fact, you _must_ vary your start times (e.g., working at 10:00 PM PHT one day, and 7:00 AM PHT the next) to maintain a natural human pattern.

    



## Job Requirements



- **Absolute Attention to Detail:** A single careless click (like granting location permissions or checking personal accounts in the work profile) will break the proxy protocol and fail the project.

    

- **No Automation/Bots:** You must physically use your mouse and keyboard erratically (hovering, highlighting text, Imprecise scrolling) just like a real person.

- **Long-Term Promotion:** If you successfully complete this sprint with high-quality logs, you will be fast-tracked for a permanent, long-term channel management position with our team.

title: AI Website Designer And Developer
description:
## Company: Atmospheric Thinking



## Position Type: Website Design & Development



## Department: Digital / Web Development



## Reports To: Project Manager & CEO



## Role Type: Internal Team Role



## Client-Facing: No phone or video calls required



## About the Role



Atmospheric Thinking is looking for an **AI Website Designer & Developer** to help build, update, and manage websites across multiple platforms and internal projects. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable using AI tools, modern website builders, and project management systems to move quickly while maintaining strong quality, organization, and communication.



This position will focus on building websites using platforms such as **Squarespace, Wix, Elementor, Webflow, Lovable, and other major website builders**. The ideal candidate should be highly adaptable, comfortable learning new tools, and able to manage a large number of projects at once.



A major part of this role will include using **Lovable daily** for both internal and external projects. The person in this position should be able to use AI-assisted development tools to create website pages, dashboards, landing pages, internal tools, client deliverables, prototypes, and other web-based assets.



This is not a client-facing role involving phone calls or video meetings. However, the role will still support client deliverables, including website updates, revision notes, report dashboards, draft
s, internal documentation, project updates, and other materials needed to support client work.



The team will also have **daily start-of-day calls** to review current tasks, priorities, blockers, deadlines, and project expectations.



## Key Responsibilities



### Website Design & Development



* Build, edit, and maintain websites using platforms such as Squarespace, Wix, Elementor, Webflow, Lovable, and other major website builders.

* Create websites, landing pages, service pages, location pages, blog layouts, forms, and basic conversion-focused page structures.

* Use AI tools to speed up website creation, content layout, wireframing, development, testing, and revisions.

* Work on both external client websites and internal Atmospheric Thinking projects.

* Use Lovable regularly to build web-based tools, dashboards, prototypes, internal systems, and client-facing digital assets.

* Translate project requirements into clean, functional, and visually organized website pages.

* Make website revisions based on internal notes, client feedback, QA reviews, and project manager instructions.

* Ensure websites are mobile-friendly, responsive, and easy to navigate.

* Follow brand guidelines, project instructions, and established design direction.



### AI & Tool Usage



* Use AI tools daily to assist with website development, content structuring, design support, troubleshooting, and workflow efficiency.

* Use Lovable on a regular basis for multiple internal and external projects.

* Stay comfortable experimenting with new AI tools, website builders, plugins, integrations, and development workflows.

* Use AI responsibly while still reviewing work for accuracy, design quality, and client readiness.

* Help improve internal processes for using AI in website design and development.



### Project Management & Organization



* Use ClickUp or similar project management systems to manage tasks, deadlines, notes, priorities, and updates.

* Handle a large caseload of website and development-related projects at one time.

* Keep project tasks organized and updated consistently.

* Provide clear written updates on project progress, blockers, completed work, pending items, and next steps.

* Attend daily start-of-day calls to review priorities and align on current responsibilities.

* Follow assigned timelines and communicate early when a deadline, task, or project requirement needs clarification.

* Balance multiple projects without losing track of details, feedback, or deliverables.



### Client Deliverable Support



Although this role is not client-facing through phone or video calls, it will involve preparing and supporting client deliverables such as:



* Website drafts and revision updates.

* Report dashboards.

* Internal and client-facing notes.

* Draft
s for project updates.

* Website QA notes.

* Revision summaries.

* Progress updates.

* Design and development documentation.

* Screenshots, walkthrough notes, or project summaries when needed.



### Quality Assurance



* Review websites for visual consistency, mobile responsiveness, broken links, formatting issues, missing content, and usability problems.

* Test forms, buttons, links, embedded elements, and basic user flows.

* Ensure completed work matches the assigned task instructions.

* Make sure website pages are polished before being submitted for internal review.

* Pay close attention to spacing, layout, readability, design consistency, and basic SEO structure.



## Required Skills & Experience



* Experience building websites using one or more major website builders such as Squarespace, Wix, Elementor, Webflow, Shopify, or similar platforms.

* Comfortable using AI tools to support website creation, development, project execution, and workflow improvements.

* Experience or strong willingness to use Lovable daily.

* Ability to learn new website platforms, AI tools, and internal systems quickly.

* Strong understanding of website structure, page layouts, responsive design, and user-friendly navigation.

* Ability to manage multiple projects at once while staying organized.

* Strong written communication skills.

* Ability to provide consistent updates without needing constant reminders.

* Comfortable working in ClickUp or another project management platform.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Ability to follow instructions, revise work based on feedback, and meet deadlines.

* Comfortable working independently after receiving direction.



## Preferred Skills



* Experience with Elementor and WordPress.

* Experience with Webflow.

* Experience with Lovable or similar AI app-building tools.

* Basic understanding of SEO-friendly website structure.

* Basic understanding of landing page design and conversion-focused layouts.

* Experience creating dashboards, internal tools, or simple web apps.

* Basic HTML, CSS, or JavaScript knowledge is a plus but not required.

* Experience working for a digital agency, marketing agency, web design company, or similar environment.

* Familiarity with tools such as Canva, Figma, Google Workspace, Slack, ClickUp, ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI platforms.



## Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys building websites, learning new tools, and using AI to move faster without sacrificing quality. They should be highly organized, comfortable juggling multiple projects, and able to provide consistent project updates.



This person does not need to be on client calls, but they should understand that their work directly supports client deliverables. They should be able to take direction, work through revisions, and help bring website projects from idea to completion.



They should also be comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities may shift, multiple projects may be active at once, and daily communication is important.



## Daily Expectations



* Attend daily start-of-day calls to review priorities and current tasks.

* Check ClickUp or the assigned project management system regularly.

* Update tasks with progress, blockers, and completed work.

* Work on multiple website design and development tasks throughout the day.

* Use Lovable and other AI tools consistently.

* Complete assigned website updates, builds, revisions, dashboards, notes, and internal deliverables.

* Communicate clearly when something is completed, delayed, blocked, or needs review.



## Success in This Role Looks Like



* Website projects are completed accurately and on time.

* ClickUp tasks are consistently updated.

* Internal tea
mbers always know the status of assigned projects.

* Lovable and AI tools are used effectively to speed up development.

* The person can manage multiple projects without losing track of details.

* Website revisions are handled quickly and carefully.

* Client deliverables are organized, professional, and ready for review.

* Daily communication is clear, reliable, and helpful.

* Work quality improves over time as the person learns Atmospheric Thinking’s systems and expectations.



## Work Style



This role is best for someone who is:



* Detail-oriented.

* Organized.

* Comfortable with fast-moving projects.

* A strong written communicator.

* Tech-savvy.

* Comfortable with AI tools.

* Good at problem-solving.

* Able to work independently.

* Open to feedback.

* Reliable with updates and deadlines.

* Interested in website design, AI development, and digital systems.



## Summary



The **AI Website Designer & Developer** at Atmospheric Thinking will be responsible for building websites, supporting client deliverables, using AI tools daily, and helping the team manage a wide range of internal and external web projects. This role requires strong organization, comfort with multiple website builders, regular use of Lovable, and the ability to manage a high-volume workload with clear and consistent communication.

title: Reverse Recruiter (Virtual) — Drive My Job Search (Proactive | English-Speaking | Tech-Savvy | AI-Fluent)
description:
About the role



I'm looking for a highly motivated, detail-obsessed, and assertive Reverse Recruiter to manage my job search end-to-end. This is not a passive role. I need someone who takes ownership, drives the process, and holds me accountable — not the other way around. If I go quiet, follow up. If a deadline is approaching, flag it. If there's a better way to do something, bring it to me with a solution, not a question.



You'll research opportunities, tailor application materials, submit on my behalf, and keep everything meticulously organized — operating largely independently, without hand-holding.



What you'll do

- Search relevant job listings daily across LinkedIn, Indeed, ZipRecruiter, Monster, Glassdoor, company career pages, and any other high-yield sources you identify

- Tailor my resume and cover letter to each job description — thoughtful customization, not find-and-replace

- Submit applications through portals or
 on my behalf — complete, accurate, and polished every time

- Maintain a detailed application tracker in Google Sheets (company, role, date applied, link, status, follow-up actions)

- Proactively follow up on submitted applications at appropriate intervals, without being asked

- Flag interview requests, recruiter messages, or any responses immediately — don't wait for a check-in

- Remind me of actions on my end, and follow up if I'm slow to respond

- Continuously identify ways to improve the process and bring them forward



Work style — non-negotiable

- You're a self-starter who doesn't wait to be told what to do next. You anticipate needs, solve problems before they become problems, and keep things moving at all times. You're organized to a fault, proactive by default, and comfortable holding a client accountable: if something's overdue, you say so; if something could be done better, you say so. I want someone who's on top of this at all times — not someone I have to chase.



Experience

- Demonstrated experience managing job searches and submitting applications on behalf of clients

- A track record of success — clients who received interviews, offers, or landed roles as a result of your work

- Prior experience with clients in the technology sector (software, product, data, IT) is a strong plus

- A background in VA work, recruiting, or HR is advantageous



Technical skills

- Proficient in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive) and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel)

- Strong, impeccable English writing — you'll be customizing professional documents

- Familiarity with LinkedIn, Indeed, and other major US job boards is required



AI proficiency — highly valued

The ability to use AI tools effectively is a strong differentiator. Preference, in order:

- Claude (Anthropic) — highest preference; specific familiarity with Claude is a meaningful advantage

- ChatGPT / OpenAI — highly valued

- Any other AI/LLM tools (Gemini, Copilot, Jasper, etc.) — valued

- No AI experience — considered, but ranked lower



How to apply

I review applications only through my hiring page — not through OnlineJobs messages. Apply here: zurl.to/NZBM



It takes about 5 minutes. You'll share your experience with job boards, one or two specific client outcomes, how you stay organized, the AI tools you use, your rate and earliest start date, and your availability for a quick 30-minute intro call. Please apply through the link rather than replying here.

title: Dispatcher / Logistics Co-Ordinator
description:
About Us

We place donation bins at libraries, churches, schools, town recycling centers, and businesses across the Northeast, then route a fleet of trucks to collect books and media on a recurring schedule. We also handle one-off home pickups and large-volume cleanouts. Reliable collection and responsive communication with our hosts and donors are the backbone of the business.



We run our routing and dispatch through WorkWave Route Manager and coordinate a small team of drivers across multiple trucks every day.



The Role

We're looking for a sharp, organized Executive Assistant / Virtual Assistant to be the communication and coordination hub of our daily operations. You'll be the first point of contact for customer messages and support
s, and you'll work hand-in-hand with our drivers to make sure every truck hits its stops on time. This is a fast-moving role where no two days look the same  you keep the wheels turning.



What You'll Do

Customer & Host Support



Monitor and respond to support
s and customer messages promptly and professionally (bin hosts, donors, home-pickup requests, and general inquiries).

Answer common questions, schedule pickups, handle rescheduling, and resolve issues or escalate when needed.

Keep every conversation warm, clear, and on-brand,  you're often the only "voice" of the company a customer hears.

Dispatch & Driver Coordination



Work daily in WorkWave Route Manager to monitor routes, stops, and driver progress.

Communicate with drivers throughout the day,  confirm they have their stop list, help them stay on schedule, relay address/access/hours details, and troubleshoot in real time (traffic, closed locations, missed stops, last-minute additions).

Adjust and reorder stops as situations change, and make sure overdue or time-sensitive pickups don't fall through the cracks.

Flag problems early and keep operations informed.

General Coordination



Track open requests and follow-ups so nothing gets lost.

Help keep records and route information accurate and up to date.

Pitch in on administrative and operational tasks as the day demands.

What You Must Have

Perfect, fluent written and spoken English — clear, polished, professional communication is non-negotiable for this role.

Ability to work odd / flexible hours when needed — routes run early and situations come up; you're comfortable being reachable outside a standard 9–5 when the day requires it.

Strong organizational skills and the ability to juggle multiple conversations and moving pieces at once.

Calm, solution-oriented attitude under pressure — when a driver is running behind or a customer is frustrated, you keep things steady.

Comfortable learning and working in web-based software (we'll train you on WorkWave and our internal tools).

Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace, and a dependable computer and phone.

Nice to Have

Prior experience in dispatch, logistics, route coordination, or fleet/driver management.

Customer service or support-desk background.

Experience with WorkWave, CRMs, or similar scheduling/routing platforms.

The Opportunity

This is a real opportunity for the right person. There is no salary cap — we're looking for one dedicated, all-in person who wants to grow with us, and the earning potential is significant for someone who proves they can own this role. The harder and smarter you work, the more you make.



How to Apply

Please follow these instructions exactly — attention to detail is the first thing we're screening for:



Do not reply to this posting here. All applications must come by
.

 
 BANNANA in the subject line of your
.

title: Senior Video Editor (Luxury Real Estate )
description:
Senior Video Editor (Luxury Real Estate)



Full-Time Position



We are a luxury real estate media company seeking a full-time Senior Video Editor who specializes in crafting high-end, cinematic property films. This role is for a highly skilled professional who understands storytelling, pacing, and premium color—and can consistently deliver polished, luxury-level video content.



About the Role



As our Senior Video Editor, you will be responsible for editing a steady volume of luxury real estate videos, including cinematic property tours, agent-led videos, and brand storytelling content.



Every project should reflect a refined, high-end aesthetic—clean edits, intentional pacing, natural yet elevated color grading, and seamless motion. This is not a template-driven role. We value precision, consistency, and creative craftsmanship.



Required Expertise

- 8+ years of professional video editing experience (senior level)

- Strong background in:

- Luxury real estate video editing

- Cinematic property tours

- Agent/on-camera videos

- Story-driven brand content



Advanced expertise in:

- High-end color grading (natural, clean, luxury tone)

- DaVinci Resolve (required)

- Speed ramping and motion timing

- Music-driven editing and pacing

- Clean, professional captioning for social and branding



Deep understanding of:

- Visual storytelling and narrative flow

- Shot selection and sequencing

- Matching footage across multiple cameras and lighting conditions

- Maintaining consistency across projects and clients



Technical Requirements / Advanced proficiency in:

- DaVinci Resolve (primary editing platform)

- Strong working knowledge of:

- Color management and node-based grading workflows

- Export settings for social media, MLS, and high-end marketing use



Strictly no reliance on:

AI-generated edits

Auto-cutting or template-based platforms



What We’re Looking For



A dedicated full-time editor—not a freelancer splitting attention.

Someone who understands luxury pacing—when to slow down, when to build energy

Strong attention to detail (no sloppy cuts, mismatched color, or over-editing)

Ability to create emotion-driven edits, not just compile clips

Reliable communication and consistent turnaround times

Alignment with a premium, luxury brand aesthetic



Nice to Have

Experience editing $1M+ luxury listings

Familiarity with real estate marketing trends and agent branding

Experience working with drone footage and gimbal-based walkthroughs



What Success Looks Like



Videos feel intentional, cinematic, and elevated

Agents look natural, confident, and well-paced on camera

Every project reinforces a luxury brand standard

Consistent quality across high volume without sacrificing detail

title: Creative Operations Assistant & Short-Form Video Editor for UK Marketing Agency
description:
Job Type



Part-time to start, with the opportunity to become full-time.



Salary



$700–$900 per month depending on skill, experience and output quality.



We are happy to pay more for someone who is genuinely good at short-form ad editing, understands creative quality, can work independently and can help us build a long-term content production system.



This role will begin with a 30-day paid trial. If the trial goes well, this can become a long-term monthly role with more responsibility and potential bonuses.



About Us



We are ClickBright, a growing UK marketing agency that works mainly with hospitality businesses, restaurants, venues, tanning salons and local service businesses.



We run paid advertising campaigns for clients and help them turn raw content into high-performing video ads, social content, lead-generation campaigns and customer acquisition systems.



We are looking for someone who can help us create better video ads, organise client content, research creative ideas and support the production side of the agency.



What You Will Be Doing



Your main responsibility will be editing short-form video ads from raw footage.



You will be editing content for:



*
 Ads

* Instagram Ads

* Reels

* TikTok-style videos

* Talking-head agency videos

* Restaurant and hospitality ads

* Tanning salon ads

* Local business ads



You will also help with basic creative operations, including:



* Creating simple static ad graphics in Canva

* Resizing videos into 9:16, 4:5 and 1:1 formats

* Adding captions/subtitles

* Adding hooks, headlines and motion graphics

* Organising raw footage in Google Drive

* Preparing edited files for ad campaigns

* Researching competitors and creative examples

* Helping prepare content ideas and shot lists

* Helping request the right footage from clients

* Briefing and organising creative work clearly



The Type of Editing We Need



We are not looking for basic slideshow editing.



We need someone who understands modern short-form ad editing.



The edits should feel:



* clean

* premium

* fast-paced where needed

* easy to understand

* attention-grabbing in the first 3 seconds

* suitable for paid ads

* not over-edited

* not cheap-looking

* not full of random effects



You should understand:



* hooks

* captions

* pacing

* B-roll

* text overlays

* ad-style editing

* clean transitions

* motion graphics

* social media formats

* how to make simple raw footage look professional



Tools You Should Be Comfortable With



You do not need to use every tool listed, but you should be comfortable with at least some of these:



* CapCut

* Adobe Premiere Pro

* After Effects

* Canva

* Google Drive

* Google Docs

* Google Sheets

* ChatGPT or AI tools

* AI image/ad tools where useful



We are happy for you to use AI tools to speed up the process, especially for basic static ads, design ideas, captions and creative research, as long as the final output looks professional.



Bonus Skills



These are not required, but would be very useful:



* Experience editing paid ads

* Experience with Meta/Facebook Ads creatives

* Experience with restaurants, venues, beauty, tanning or local businesses

* Canva design skills

* Copywriting or hook writing

* Competitor research

* Creative strategy

* Social media content planning

* Ability to turn a simple client idea into a clear content brief

* Good written English

* Comfortable communicating with a UK-based agency



What We Do Not Want



Please do not apply if:



* you only do very basic edits

* you cannot follow references

* you need constant hand-holding

* you miss deadlines

* you are not organised

* you cannot work with Google Drive

* your edits look outdated

* you only use templates without thinking

* you cannot take feedback professionally



Trial Task



Shortlisted applicants will be given a paid test task.



The test will involve editing a short video ad from raw footage and creating a simple static ad graphic.



We will judge based on:



* quality of the hook

* pacing

* captions

* text overlays

* overall look

* how suitable it is for paid ads

* file organisation

* communication

* turnaround time



Long-Term Opportunity



If you do well, this can become a long-term role.



As the agency grows, there may also be opportunities for:



* higher monthly pay

* performance bonuses

* client-retention bonuses

* more responsibility

* full-time work

* creative strategist responsibilities

* managing other editors in the future



We are building a proper agency team, not just hiring someone for a few random tasks.



How To Apply



Please reply with the word “CLICKBRIGHT7741” at the top of your application so I know you read the full job post.



Then answer these questions:



1. What video editing software do you use?

2. Send 3 examples of short-form videos or ads you have edited.

3. Have you edited paid ads before? If yes, what type?

4. Are you comfortable creating simple static ads in Canva?

5. Are you comfortable using Google Drive to organise files?

6. Are you able to work part-time, around 25–30 hours per week?

7. What monthly salary are you looking for?

8. How quickly can you usually complete a 30–60 second short-form ad edit?

9. Are you comfortable doing a paid test task?

10. Why do you think you would be a good fit for this role?



Applications without examples of previous work will not be considered.

title: SEO & AI Search Optimization Specialist
description:
# Job Title: SEO & AI Search Optimization Specialist



## Company: Atmospheric Thinking



## Position Type: SEO / Digital Marketing



## Department: SEO & Organic Growth



## Reports To: SEO Manager / Project Manager / Operations Lead



## Role Type: Internal Team Role



## Client-Facing: No phone or video calls required



## About the Role



Atmospheric Thinking is looking for an **SEO & AI Search Optimization Specialist** to support client and internal SEO projects across technical SEO, keyword research, backlink analysis, content optimization, analytics, reporting, and emerging AI search strategies.



This role is ideal for someone who understands both traditional SEO and the newer ways people are discovering businesses through AI-powered search tools, generative search engines, answer engines, and AI assistants. The ideal candidate should be comfortable using major SEO tools, analyzing website performance, identifying ranking opportunities, preparing deliverables, and keeping projects organized across a large caseload.



This is not a client-facing role involving phone calls or video meetings. However, the role will still support client deliverables, including SEO reports, dashboards, revision notes, draft
s, keyword research documents, audit summaries, backlink notes, implementation recommendations, and other project materials.



The team will also have **daily start-of-day calls** to review current tasks, priorities, blockers, deadlines, and expectations.



## Key Responsibilities



### SEO Strategy & Execution



* Perform keyword research and keyword analysis for client websites, service pages, blogs, local SEO pages, landing pages, and content strategies.

* Identify ranking opportunities based on search volume, keyword difficulty, user intent, competitor gaps, and business value.

* Create keyword maps and content recommendations for website pages, blogs, service pages, city pages, and industry pages.

* Support on-page SEO improvements, including title tags, meta descriptions, headings, internal linking, URL structure, image alt text, and content optimization.

* Review website content and provide recommendations to improve rankings, user experience, and organic visibility.

* Help develop SEO strategies that support lead generation, local visibility, brand awareness, and long-term organic growth.



### AI SEO, Generative Search & Answer Engine Optimization



* Stay informed on new methods used to rank and appear in AI-powered search experiences.

* Support optimization for generative search, AI overviews, answer engines, and AI assistant-style search results.

* Research how businesses can improve visibility across AI-driven discovery platforms.

* Help structure content so it is easier for search engines and AI systems to understand, summarize, and reference.

* Recommend content formats that support answer engine optimization, including FAQs, direct-answer sections, entity-based content, comparison content, service explanations, and structured data.

* Use ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools to support research, content outlines, optimization recommendations, reporting, and workflow efficiency.

* Review AI-assisted work carefully for accuracy, quality, and SEO value.



### Technical SEO



* Conduct technical SEO audits using tools such as Screaming Frog, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, and other SEO platforms.

* Identify and document technical issues such as crawl errors, indexation problems, broken links, redirect issues, duplicate content, thin content, missing metadata, page speed concerns, sitemap issues, robots.txt problems, and canonicalization issues.

* Review website architecture, internal linking, crawlability, and indexability.

* Support schema markup recommendations and implementation planning.

* Help test and validate schema implementations using appropriate tools.

* Work with website developers or internal tea
mbers to communicate technical SEO updates clearly.

* Monitor website health and flag issues that may impact rankings, traffic, or search visibility.



### Analytics, Tracking & Reporting



* Use Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, Bing Webmaster Tools, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and other reporting tools to monitor SEO performance.

* Help build, update, and maintain SEO report dashboards.

* Track keyword rankings, organic traffic, impressions, clicks, backlinks, conversions, indexing status, and other SEO KPIs.

* Use Google Sheets and Google Docs to organize research, audits, reports, notes, and client deliverables.

* Prepare written summaries explaining SEO performance, completed work, opportunities, and recommended next steps.

* Support draft
s, reporting notes, revision notes, dashboard updates, and internal project documentation.

* Ensure reports are accurate, organized, and ready for internal review before delivery.



### Backlink Analysis & Link Building



* Conduct backlink analysis using Ahrefs, SEMrush, and other backlink tools.

* Review competitor backlink profiles to identify link-building opportunities.

* Identify toxic, low-quality, or suspicious backlinks when needed.

* Support backlink-building campaigns through research, prospecting, outreach preparation, and relationship-building opportunities.

* Help create backlink notes, outreach lists, partnership opportunities, and link acquisition recommendations.

* Google Sheets

* Google Docs

s.

* Strong understanding of keyword research, search intent, competitor analysis, and on-page SEO.

* Experience using SEO tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, and Google Analytics.

* Experience with conversion tracking and event setup through Google Tag Manager.

* Experience researching AI search visibility, entity SEO, topical authority, and answer engine optimization.



## Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is someone who understands SEO deeply enough to identify problems, explain opportunities, and complete detailed research without needing constant supervision. They should be highly organized, comfortable working across multiple client projects, and able to provide clear written updates on progress, blockers, and next steps.



This person should enjoy analyzing websites, finding ranking opportunities, reviewing competitors, building SEO reports, and staying current with changes in Google search, Bing search, AI-powered search, and generative answer engines.



They do not need to speak with clients on calls, but they should understand that their work directly supports client deliverables. Their reports, notes, audits, and recommendations should be clear, professional, and ready for internal review.



## Daily Expectations

* Check ClickUp or the assigned project management system regularly.

* Update tasks with progress, blockers, completed work, and next steps.

* Work on keyword research, technical SEO audits, backlink analysis, dashboards, reports, content optimization, and SEO implementation notes.

s, revision notes, audit notes, and project updates.

## Success in This Role Looks Like

mbers always know the status of assigned SEO projects.

title: Executive Assistant (Virtual) — Be My Right Hand (Proactive | Tech-Savvy | AI-Fluent)
description:
About the role



I'm looking for a reliable, self-directed Executive Assistant to be my right hand on day-to-day admin. There's no fixed checklist — tasks vary week to week — so I need someone who can take a loose instruction, run with it, and follow through without being chased. The schedule is flexible within a 10am–4pm EST window, so you can plan your day around it. If you like variety, take initiative, and are comfortable speaking with US-based companies by phone, this is for you.



What you'll do



- Handle general administrative tasks as they come up

- Research vendors, compare options, and help me make decisions

- Make phone calls to US companies on my behalf (scheduling, inquiries, follow-ups)

- Manage and organize my calendar

- Send reminders and chase down follow-ups so nothing slips

- General research on topics I assign



Work style — non-negotiable

- You're a self-starter who doesn't wait to be told what to do next. You anticipate needs, solve problems before they become problems, and keep things moving at all times. You're organized to a fault, proactive by default, and comfortable holding a client accountable: if something's overdue, you say so; if something could be done better, you say so. I want someone who's on top of this at all times — not someone I have to chase.



A plus (not required):

Occasionally I may need help coordinating the hiring of other freelancers/agents for a job-search project. This is a specialized task, not part of the core role — but if you have experience sourcing, vetting, or managing other VAs/freelancers, say so. It's a strong advantage.



What I'm looking for:

- Excellent spoken and written English — a clear, confident phone presence is essential, since you'll be calling US companies

- Strong organization and attention to detail

- Proactive and dependable — you follow up without being reminded

- Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision

- Reliable internet and a quiet space for calls

- Available consistently within the core 10am–4pm EST window

- Familiarity with calendar tools (Google Calendar),
, and basic research



AI proficiency — highly valued

The ability to use AI tools effectively is a strong differentiator. Preference, in order:

- Claude (Anthropic) — highest preference; specific familiarity with Claude is a meaningful advantage

- ChatGPT / OpenAI — highly valued

- Any other AI/LLM tools (Gemini, Copilot, Jasper, etc.) — valued

- No AI experience — considered, but ranked lower



How to apply: 

I review applications only through my hiring page — not through OnlineJobs messages. Apply here: 



It takes about 5 minutes. You'll answer a few short questions (how you work, your phone experience, your AI tools), share your rate and earliest start date, and pick your availability for a quick 30-minute intro call. Please apply through the link rather than replying here.

title: Senior E-commerce Operations VA – Australian Online Retailer
description:
ABOUT US



We're an established Australian online retailer (founded 2013) with a lean, remote team that runs a high-volume e-commerce operation. We sell across our own BigCommerce store, handle dropship and warehouse orders, and deal directly with trade and retail customers. We're not a startup — we have real systems, real processes, and we expect real performance.



ABOUT THE ROLE



This is an operations-focused VA role. You'll be working inside our actual systems daily — not doing generic admin. You'll process orders, coordinate with suppliers, send quotes and invoices, handle customer
s, and keep things moving. 



Day-to-day responsibilities include:



* Processing customer orders accurately in our order management system (Cin7)

* Sending quotations and invoices to customers

* Coordinating with suppliers for dropship orders, stock checks, and ETAs

* Following up with suppliers and customers on outstanding matters

* Handling customer enquiries via
 (and occasionally phone)

* Updating order statuses and maintaining accurate records

* Assisting with general e-commerce operations tasks as needed



TOOLS YOU'LL USE



We run a specific tech stack. Experience with any of these is a genuine advantage:



* Cin7 – inventory and order management (most important)

* Front – shared inbox / customer communications

* BigCommerce – our storefront

* Google Workspace – Docs, Sheets, Gmail, Drive

* Slack – internal team comms



You don't need to know all of these. But you must be genuinely tech-comfortable and able to learn systems quickly without hand-holding.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



* Proven e-commerce VA experience — order processing, supplier comms, customer support. Not general admin.

* Excellent written English — clear, professional, no errors

* Strong attention to detail — mistakes in orders or quotes cost us money

* Proactive and reliable — you follow up without being reminded

* Comfortable working inside structured systems and SOPs

* Stable computer setup and internet connection

* Quiet, professional work environment



This role is not suited to someone who needs constant supervision or is looking for easy tasks. It suits someone who takes pride in getting operational details right.



HOURS



* Monday to Friday

* 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM Sydney time (AEST/AEDT) to start — approximately 20 hours/week

* No weekend work

* Availability during these hours is a hard requirement

* Strong performers may grow into full-time hours over time



PAY & GROWTH



* Competitive hourly rate based on experience — paid weekly

* Performance-based bonuses for reliability and quality

* Stable long-term role with a real path to senior ops responsibility

* You'll be working closely with the business owner and learning how a real Australian e-commerce operation runs



HOW TO APPLY



To confirm you've read this carefully, start your application with the word LIGHTHOUSE on the first line.

Then please answer all of the following:



* How many years of e-commerce VA experience do you have, and what types of tasks did you handle?

* Which platforms or systems from our stack have you used? (Cin7, Front, BigCommerce, Shopify, etc.)

* Have you processed customer orders or coordinated directly with suppliers before? Describe briefly.

* What is your hourly rate expectation in USD?



Please also include a short paragraph on why this role suits you specifically — not a generic cover letter.

Applications without LIGHTHOUSE or missing answers will not be reviewed.

• Our website — keeping [WordPress / Webflow / Shopify] fast, clean, and conversion-focused

• A track record you can show — with real numbers and baselines, not just adjectives

• An organic-first mindset: you think in months and compounding, not overnight wins

Channel	Depth you need

SEO — technical, on-page, local	Deep — this is the growth engine

Content & copywriting	Deep — fuels both rankings and conversions

Web (WordPress / Webflow / Shopify, CRO)	Competent — can build and improve pages

Analytics (GA4, Search Console, reporting)	Competent — can measure and explain results

Paid ads (Google, Meta)	Working — runs a small budget without waste

Social & Google Business Profile	Working — consistent upkeep, local visibility

Nice to have

• Experience in Restaurant/Fast-Food

• Basic HTML/CSS and page-speed know-how

•
 marketing and conversion-rate optimization experience

Why this role

• One role, real ownership — you run the whole channel, not a sliver of it

• We’re in it for the long game and will give organic the time it needs to work

• Clear, measurable goals and the autonomy to hit them

How to apply

Send a short note telling us (1) one organic-growth result you’re proud of and the numbers behind it, and (2) the first three things you’d look at on our site. Attach your résumé and a link to your portfolio or past work.
 
 with the subject “[Marketing Generalist — Your Name].”

title: Content Strategist
description:
We are looking for a part-time content strategist to work alongside an established video marketing and monetization brand. This is not an entry-level role. We need someone who has done this before, can prove it, and has a clear system for how they work.



About the brand



Keenya Kelly is a video marketing and monetization strategist with a large established audience across TikTok, Instagram, and
. We teach entrepreneurs how to grow through short vertical video and turn their content into consistent income.



We have an active offer ecosystem including a membership, a flagship course, and low-ticket funnels. We are a systems-driven team that operates with clear processes, deadlines, and communication standards.



What we are looking for



You have a proven framework or methodology for creating content that grows accounts AND drives revenue. Not just views.



Not just followers. Actual conversions and sales.



You can show us accounts you have worked on, what the numbers looked like before you got involved, and what happened after. You think in systems. You do not wing it.



You have a repeatable process for researching a brand, building a content strategy, and delivering direction that a team can execute consistently.



You understand the difference between content that builds an audience and content that converts that audience into buyers — and you know how to build both into a strategy at the same time.



What this role involves



Deep dive into the Keenya Kelly brand — audience, offers, voice, content pillars, and competitors — and develop a content strategy tailored to where we are going, not just where we have been



Deliver weekly content ideas for Instagram,
, and TikTok — including hooks, format direction, caption angles, and CTAs that connect to our active offers



Deliver Trial Reels concept per day for Instagram



Build and hand over a content system our team can run — including a competitor database, hook library, and content direction framework



Join bi-weekly strategy calls to review performance and align on the next content cycle



Adapt content direction during active launch periods — we run live challenges, webinars, and course launch campaigns that require content to shift with the offer



What this role does NOT involve



You will not be posting, scheduling, editing videos, designing graphics, managing DMs or comments, or handling any execution. Our team handles all of that. Your job is strategy and content direction only.



You are the right person if



You have a documented system or framework for content strategy — not just experience, an actual repeatable process



You can show us at least two accounts you have grown that also became more profitable — with before and after numbers



You understand short vertical video deeply — TikTok, Instagram Reels, and
 — and you know how to build strategy differently for each platform



You are highly organized and can deliver on deadlines without being chased



You are comfortable working alongside a brand owner who is also a strategist — you do not need to own the entire process

to do your best work



You communicate proactively and do not go silent when things come up



This is not the right role if



You need to control execution in order to stand behind your strategy



You are still building your process and learning as you go



You cannot provide proof of accounts you have grown and monetized



You struggle with structure, deadlines, or communicating your own process clearly



How to apply



Your application must include:



1. A brief description of your content strategy framework or system — how you approach a new brand from day one



2. Two or more examples of accounts you have grown and helped monetize — include the platform, the follower growth, and the revenue or conversion results



3. Your availability and your rate for part-time consulting work



Applications that do not include proof of results will not be reviewed.



We are looking for someone ready to work alongside an established brand, not build one from scratch.

- You come with ideas, not just questions. When we send a brief, you interpret it and make it better.

- You understand DTC and performance marketing. You know what makes someone stop scrolling.

- You deliver 2-3 variations per concept, not just one option.

- You know the difference between "beautiful" and "effective."

- Fast turnaround: 24-48 hours for a batch of ad creatives

WHAT YOUR PORTFOLIO SHOULD SHOW



- DTC ad creatives, product photography edits, or social media content (not just logos and flyers)

BRAND STYLE FOR REFERENCE



- Colors: black, white, dark red

- Aesthetic: premium, minimal, masculine

DETAILS

title: Paralegal – Criminal Defense (Law Graduate)
description:
Position Overview:

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Paralegal or Attorney to support our criminal defense practice. This role requires in-depth knowledge of criminal law, including motion preparation, legal research, and document management. The ideal candidate will be responsible for preparing motions, drafting legal documents, and ensuring compliance with legal procedures. They will work closely with attorneys to ensure the defense strategy is executed effectively, and help prepare cases for court. This is a remote position requiring exceptional written English, organizational skills, and a strong grasp of U.S. criminal law procedures fundamentals.



Key Responsibilities:



• Draft, review, and be prepared to file various legal documents including motions, briefs, and memoranda.

• Prepare appendices for motions, including organizing exhibits, declarations, and supporting documentation.

• Prepare the table of contents for legal filings, ensuring accuracy and compliance with court rules.

• Conduct in-depth legal research on complex criminal law issues and generate a research summary for the attorney.

• Analyze discovery materials to identify critical issues and inconsistencies.

• Prepare memoranda and case summaries to aid in litigation strategy.

• Assist in the preparation of motions for hearings, trials, and appeals, including motions to suppress evidence, dismiss charges, or modify bail.

• Manage case files, ensuring all relevant documents and evidence are properly documented and stored.

• Prepare discovery responses, subpoenas, and other legal documents as directed.

• Coordinate with clients, witnesses, and experts to gather information and evidence for cases.

• Maintain communication with the court, opposing counsel, and clients regarding motions, hearings, and court dates.

• Provide support during trial preparation, including organizing exhibits, trial briefs, and witness lists.

• Ensure all legal documents comply with applicable state and federal rules and deadlines.



Qualifications:



• Must be a Graduate of a law school (JD).

• Proven experience in criminal defense law, specifically in motion practice.

• Strong knowledge of court rules, procedures, and legal writing standards.

• Experience preparing appendices, tables of contents, and organizing large case files.

• Excellent research, analytical, and writing skills.

• Must have strong knowledge of legal citation

• Ability to manage multiple cases and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong communication skills and attention to detail.

• Experience with legal research tools (e.g.,Lexis/Nexis and Westlaw) and document management software, such as Clio CRM software.



Preferred:



• Prior experience in criminal defense law or litigation.

• Knowledge of specific motions in criminal defense, including motions to suppress, dismiss, and motions for bond 

        reductions.

• Familiarity with Nevada local court rules and procedures in criminal defense.



Application Process:



Interested candidates should submit the following:

• An updated resume.

• A cover letter detailing your experience with U.S. criminal law and Clio software.

• Two writing samples (legal motions or briefs preferred) with how long it required the applicant to finalize the presented 

        document (in hours) from the time the assignment was given to the document presented.

title: Appointment Setter (Clear US Accent Required): Warm Bathroom Remodeling Leads: Extremely High Earning Potential
description:
We run ads for bathroom remodeling companies across the US. Leads click our ad, get fully qualified, and are told someone will call them. Your job is to call them fast, run a short script, and book them on our client's calendar. That's it.



These are warm leads. They just raised their hand and they're expecting your call. You are not cold calling anyone.

We're looking for a killer. Someone who shows up to dominate, hits the phone hard, and wants to book as many appointments as possible because every booking is more money in your pocket. If you're the type who's happy doing the bare minimum, this isn't for you. If you're hungry and want to earn, keep reading.



What you'll do:



Watch a Slack channel during your shift for new lead notifications



Call the lead within 5 minutes of the notification (speed is the whole game here)



Open the right client's CRM, go to the Opportunities tab, hit call



Follow the script (it's in the CRM and in Slack)



Re-qualify and book the appointment on the client's GHL calendar



Done



The script and everything you need is provided. You are not building anything or figuring anything out. You call, follow the script, book.



What we need:



A clear American accent. This is non-negotiable. You're calling US homeowners and they need to feel comfortable on the phone. If there's any noticeable accent, this isn't the right role for you.



Real sales or phone experience. You can hold a conversation, handle a little hesitation, and get someone on the calendar.



A closer mindset. You want to win, you want the commissions, and you treat every lead like money on the table.



Reliable and fast. When a lead comes in, you're on it inside 5 minutes.



Good internet and a quiet place to call from.



Pay:



$3/hour base



$5 for every appointment you book



We expect a booking rate of at least 35% of the leads you call. Leads are warm and the script works, so the more you grind, the more you earn. No cap.



We're hiring one person right now. You'll handle leads across all our clients from one seat, so we want someone who can own it.



To apply:



Send a 60 to 90 second voice note. This is required. No voice note means you will not be considered at all, no exceptions. It's how we hear your accent and how you'd actually sound on the phone with our leads, so make it good.



After the voice note, the next step is a quick 5 minute call where I'll gauge your ability. If it's a fit, we onboard you fast and get you into the flow right away. We move quick here, so if you're ready to start earning, send that voice note now.

title: Luxury Travel Operations Coordinator (Remote)
description:

The role involves coordinating complex travel arrangements, handling urgent operational requests, and ensuring flawless service delivery for high-profile and luxury travel clients.

You will regularly handle urgent requests, last-minute travel changes, and multiple priorities simultaneously, often under strict deadlines. Success in this role requires exceptional attention to detail, strong organizational skills, sound judgment, and the ability to remain calm, focused, and responsive in a fast-paced environment where quick and accurate decision-making is critical.

Key Responsibilities



- Respond promptly to all incoming calls,
s, and messages related to pre-service and post-service requests.
